        // --- BOOT ANIMATION TIMING ---
        // GANTI TOTAL cara trigger-nya: sebelumnya nunggu animationend dari CSS,
        // tapi itu bisa gak konsisten di environment yang beda-beda (browser biasa
        // vs shortcut "Add to Home Screen" vs WebAPK). Sekarang pakai timer waktu
        // TETAP yang dicatat paling awal (di <head>, lihat window.__appBootStart),
        // gak gantung ke CSS animation, gak gantung ke matchMedia, gak gantung ke
        // DOM sama sekali — jadi harusnya konsisten di semua cara buka file ini.
        const BOOT_ANIM_TOTAL_MS = 5000; // dipakai juga buat cycle teks loading
        const WELCOME_EXTRA_DELAY_MIN_MS = 900;
        const WELCOME_EXTRA_DELAY_MAX_MS = 1200;
        const WELCOME_TOTAL_DELAY_MS = BOOT_ANIM_TOTAL_MS
            + WELCOME_EXTRA_DELAY_MIN_MS
            + Math.random() * (WELCOME_EXTRA_DELAY_MAX_MS - WELCOME_EXTRA_DELAY_MIN_MS);

        function afterBootAnimation(fn) {
            const bootStart = window.__appBootStart || Date.now();
            const elapsed = Date.now() - bootStart;
            const remaining = Math.max(0, WELCOME_TOTAL_DELAY_MS - elapsed);
            setTimeout(fn, remaining);
        }

                "Preparing the system.. ",
                "Preparing the system... "
            ];

                i = (i + 1) % frames.length;
                el.textContent = frames[i];
            }, 500);
            setTimeout(() => clearInterval(timer), BOOT_ANIM_TOTAL_MS);

        function showToast(msg) {
            const container = document.getElementById('toast-container');
            const toast = document.createElement('div');
            toast.className = 'toast';
            toast.innerText = msg;
            container.appendChild(toast);
            setTimeout(() => toast.remove(), 3000);
        }

        /* --- BROWSER NOTIFICATION --- */
        function updateNotifStatus() {
            const statusEl = document.getElementById('notif-status');
            if (!statusEl) return;

            if (!("Notification" in window)) {
                statusEl.innerText = "Browser ini tidak mendukung notifikasi.";
                return;
            }
            if (Notification.permission === "granted") statusEl.innerText = "Status: AKTIF ✅";
            else if (Notification.permission === "denied") statusEl.innerText = "Status: DITOLAK (ubah lewat setting browser)";
            else statusEl.innerText = "Status: BELUM DIAKTIFKAN";
        }

        function requestNotifPermission() {
            if (!("Notification" in window)) return showToast("Browser ini tidak mendukung notifikasi.");

            Notification.requestPermission().then(perm => {
                updateNotifStatus();
                if (perm === "granted") {
                    sendNotification("SYSTEM CONTROLLER", "Notifikasi berhasil diaktifkan, Hunter!");
                } else {
                    showToast("Izin notifikasi ditolak.");
                }
            });
        }

        function sendNotification(title, body) {
            if (!("Notification" in window)) return;
            if (Notification.permission !== "granted") return;
            try {
                new Notification(title, { body: body });
                playNotifSound();
            } catch (e) {
                // beberapa browser mobile butuh Service Worker, abaikan kalau gagal
            }
        }

        function formatDateLabel(isoString) {
            if (!isoString) return "Tanggal -";
            const targetDate = new Date(isoString);
            const now = new Date();
            
            const targetZero = new Date(targetDate.getFullYear(), targetDate.getMonth(), targetDate.getDate());
            const nowZero = new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth(), now.getDate());

            const diffTime = nowZero - targetZero;
            const diffDays = Math.round(diffTime / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));
            const timeFormatted = targetDate.toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' });

            if (diffDays === 0) return `Hari ini, ${timeFormatted}`;
            if (diffDays === 1) return `Kemarin, ${timeFormatted}`;
            
            const day = String(targetDate.getDate()).padStart(2, '0');
            const month = String(targetDate.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0');
            return `${day}/${month}/${targetDate.getFullYear()}, ${timeFormatted}`;
        }

        function getTodayString() {
            const d = new Date();
            return `${d.getFullYear()}-${String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0')}-${String(d.getDate()).padStart(2, '0')}`;
        }

        function checkStreakReset() {
            const today = getTodayString();
            if (!hunter.lastStreakDate) return;

            const last = new Date(hunter.lastStreakDate);
            const now = new Date(today);
            const diffDays = Math.round((now - last) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));

            if (diffDays > 1) {
                hunter.streak = 0;
                saveData();
            }
        }

        function enterSystem() {
            const nameInput = document.getElementById('init-username').value.trim();
            const limitInput = parseInt(document.getElementById('init-limit').value);

            if (!nameInput) return showToast("Nama wajib diisi!");
            // FIX: batas atas 20 dihapus karena bentrok dengan limit permanen dari shop
            // (Extra Quest Slot / Hunter Backpack) yang bisa melebihi 20.
            if (!limitInput || limitInput < 1) return showToast("Limit harus valid (minimal 1)!");

            hunter.name = nameInput;
            hunter.limit = limitInput;

            if (hunter.firstTime) {
                hunter.firstTime = false;
            }

            document.getElementById('lobby-screen').style.display = 'none';
            checkStreakReset();
            checkAutoGenerateDaily();
            checkBossWeeklyReset();
            saveData();
            refreshUI();
            // FIX: dulu popup welcome muncul langsung pas tombol diklik, jadi
            // numpuk barengan sama animasi boot yang masih jalan. Sekarang
            // nunggu animasi boot selesai dulu baru popup welcome nongol.
            afterBootAnimation(showSystemAlert);
        }

        /* --- SYSTEM TOAST ("Welcome, Nama") --- */
        // Toast auto-dismiss sendiri kaya notifikasi WA, tapi tetep bisa

        const SYSTEM_TOAST_AUTO_DISMISS_MS = 3500;
        let systemToastDismissTimer = null;

        function showSystemAlert() {
            const modal = document.getElementById('system-alert-modal');
            const nameEl = document.getElementById('system-alert-name');
            if (nameEl) nameEl.innerText = hunter.name || 'Player';

            modal.classList.add('active');

            systemToastDismissTimer = setTimeout(dismissSystemAlert, SYSTEM_TOAST_AUTO_DISMISS_MS);
        }

        function dismissSystemAlert() {
            const modal = document.getElementById('system-alert-modal');
            modal.classList.remove('active');
            clearTimeout(systemToastDismissTimer);
        }

        // FIX: sebelumnya Enter cuma didengar dari dalam input field. Kalau
        // input itu belum sempat ke-focus (misalnya karena ketutup animasi
        // boot di awal), Enter jadi keliatan "gak berfungsi". Sekarang Enter
        // didengar dari seluruh dokumen selama lobby masih tampil.
        document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
            const lobby = document.getElementById('lobby-screen');
            if (lobby && lobby.style.display !== 'none' && e.key === 'Enter') {
                e.preventDefault();
                enterSystem();
            }
        });

        /* --- HP / MP / FATIGUE SYSTEM --- */
        function mpCostForDiff(diff) {
            if (diff === 'EASY') return 10;
            if (diff === 'HARD') return 50;
            return 25; // NORMAL
        }

        // VIT nambah max HP: base 10 gak dihitung, tiap poin VIT di atas 10 = +1 max HP.
        function computeMaxHp() {
            return 100 + Math.max(0, (hunter.vit || 10) - 10);
        }

        // AGI & INT nambah max MP: base 10 gak dihitung, tiap poin di atas 10 = +1 max MP (masing-masing).
        function computeMaxMp() {
            const extraAgi = Math.max(0, (hunter.agi || 10) - 10);
            const extraInt = Math.max(0, (hunter.int || 10) - 10);
            return 200 + extraAgi + extraInt;
        }

        // AGI & INT juga bikin ambang "buru-buru" Fatigue (default 60 detik) makin
        // longgar: tiap poin AGI/INT di atas 10 nambah 10 detik ke ambangnya.
        function computeFatigueWindowMs() {
            const extraAgi = Math.max(0, (hunter.agi || 10) - 10);
            const extraInt = Math.max(0, (hunter.int || 10) - 10);
            return 60 * 1000 + (extraAgi + extraInt) * 10 * 1000;
        }

        // Samain hunter.maxHp/maxMp dengan hasil hitungan stat terbaru, dan
        // pastiin hp/mp gak kelebihan cap kalau stat-nya turun (reset dll).
        function syncVitalCaps() {
            hunter.maxHp = computeMaxHp();
            hunter.maxMp = computeMaxMp();
            if (hunter.hp > hunter.maxHp) hunter.hp = hunter.maxHp;
            if (hunter.mp > hunter.maxMp) hunter.mp = hunter.maxMp;
        }

        function isHpDepleted() {
            return (hunter.hp || 0) <= 0;
        }

        function isFatigued() {
            return !!hunter.fatigueUntil && Date.now() < hunter.fatigueUntil;
        }

        function fatigueRemainingText() {
            const ms = Math.max(0, hunter.fatigueUntil - Date.now());
            const m = Math.floor(ms / 60000);
            const s = Math.floor((ms % 60000) / 1000);
            return `${m}:${String(s).padStart(2, '0')}`;
        }

        // Regen pasif HP (+1/20 menit) & MP (+1/10 menit). Dipanggil tiap detik
        // dari loop timer utama; hitungannya berbasis selisih waktu asli jadi
        // tetap akurat walau tab di-minimize / device sleep.
        function regenVitals() {
            const now = Date.now();
            let changed = false;

            syncVitalCaps();

            const HP_INTERVAL = 20 * 60 * 1000;
            if (!hunter.lastHpTick) hunter.lastHpTick = now;
            if (hunter.hp < hunter.maxHp) {
                const elapsed = now - hunter.lastHpTick;
                if (elapsed >= HP_INTERVAL) {
                    const gained = Math.floor(elapsed / HP_INTERVAL);
                    hunter.hp = Math.min(hunter.maxHp, hunter.hp + gained);
                    hunter.lastHpTick += gained * HP_INTERVAL;
                    changed = true;
                }
            } else {
                hunter.lastHpTick = now;
            }

            const MP_INTERVAL = 10 * 60 * 1000;
            if (!hunter.lastMpTick) hunter.lastMpTick = now;
            if (hunter.mp < hunter.maxMp) {
                const elapsed = now - hunter.lastMpTick;
                if (elapsed >= MP_INTERVAL) {
                    const gained = Math.floor(elapsed / MP_INTERVAL);
                    hunter.mp = Math.min(hunter.maxMp, hunter.mp + gained);
                    hunter.lastMpTick += gained * MP_INTERVAL;
                    changed = true;
                }
            } else {
                hunter.lastMpTick = now;
            }

            if (changed) saveData();
            updateVitalsDisplay();
        }

        // Update tampilan HP/MP/Fatigue tanpa perlu refreshUI penuh (dipanggil tiap detik)
        const FATIGUE_DURATION_MS = 5 * 60 * 1000;
        const FATIGUE_RING_CIRC = 65.97;
        // Boleh nyelesaiin sampai 3 quest berturut-turut (dalam ambang waktu
        // computeFatigueWindowMs()) sebelum kena FATIGUE. Quest ke-4 dst dalam
        // ambang waktu yang sama baru men-trigger FATIGUE.
        const FATIGUE_FREE_QUEST_LIMIT = 3;

        function formatMmSs(ms) {
            const total = Math.max(0, Math.ceil(ms / 1000));
            const m = Math.floor(total / 60);
            const s = total % 60;
            return `${m}:${String(s).padStart(2, '0')}`;
        }

        function updateVitalsDisplay() {
            syncVitalCaps();

            const hpText = document.getElementById('hp-text');
            const hpBar = document.getElementById('hp-bar');
            if (hpText) hpText.innerText = `${hunter.hp}/${hunter.maxHp}`;
            if (hpBar) hpBar.style.width = `${Math.max(0, (hunter.hp / hunter.maxHp) * 100)}%`;

            const hpNextEl = document.getElementById('hp-next-tick');
            if (hpNextEl) {
                if (hunter.hp >= hunter.maxHp) {
                    hpNextEl.innerText = '';
                } else {
                    const HP_INTERVAL = 20 * 60 * 1000;
                    const elapsed = Date.now() - (hunter.lastHpTick || Date.now());
                    const remaining = HP_INTERVAL - (elapsed % HP_INTERVAL);
                    hpNextEl.innerText = `+1 HP dalam ${formatMmSs(remaining)}`;
                }
            }

            const mpText = document.getElementById('mp-text');
            const mpBar = document.getElementById('mp-bar');
            if (mpText) mpText.innerText = `${hunter.mp}/${hunter.maxMp}`;
            if (mpBar) mpBar.style.width = `${Math.max(0, (hunter.mp / hunter.maxMp) * 100)}%`;

            const mpNextEl = document.getElementById('mp-next-tick');
            if (mpNextEl) {
                if (hunter.mp >= hunter.maxMp) {
                    mpNextEl.innerText = '';
                } else {
                    const MP_INTERVAL = 10 * 60 * 1000;
                    const elapsed = Date.now() - (hunter.lastMpTick || Date.now());
                    const remaining = MP_INTERVAL - (elapsed % MP_INTERVAL);
                    mpNextEl.innerText = `+1 MP dalam ${formatMmSs(remaining)}`;
                }
            }

            const fatigueEl = document.getElementById('fatigue-status');
            const ringFill = document.getElementById('fatigue-ring-fill');
            if (isFatigued()) {
                const remaining = hunter.fatigueUntil - Date.now();
                const fraction = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, remaining / FATIGUE_DURATION_MS));
                if (fatigueEl) { fatigueEl.innerText = fatigueRemainingText(); fatigueEl.style.color = 'var(--danger-glow)'; }
                if (ringFill) {
                    ringFill.style.stroke = 'var(--danger-glow)';
                    ringFill.style.strokeDashoffset = String(FATIGUE_RING_CIRC * (1 - fraction));
                }
            } else {
                if (fatigueEl) { fatigueEl.innerText = '-'; fatigueEl.style.color = 'var(--text-muted)'; }
                if (ringFill) {
                    ringFill.style.stroke = 'var(--text-muted)';
                    ringFill.style.strokeDashoffset = String(FATIGUE_RING_CIRC);
                }
            }
        }


        function refreshUI() {
            document.getElementById('disp-name').innerText = hunter.name;
            document.getElementById('setting-name-input').value = hunter.name;
            document.getElementById('disp-level').innerText = "LEVEL " + hunter.level;
            document.getElementById('disp-rank').innerText = ranks[hunter.rankIndex];
            document.getElementById('disp-exp-text').innerText = `${hunter.exp} / 1000 XP`;
            document.getElementById('disp-exp-bar').style.width = `${(hunter.exp / 1000) * 100}%`;
            document.getElementById('disp-gold').innerText = hunter.gold + " G";
            document.getElementById('disp-streak').innerText = hunter.streak + " Hari";
            const dispTitleEl = document.getElementById('disp-title');
            if (dispTitleEl) dispTitleEl.innerText = hunter.title || "Novice";

            document.getElementById('quest-count').innerText = quests.length;
            document.getElementById('quest-limit').innerText = hunter.limit;

            document.getElementById('st-str').innerText = hunter.str;
            document.getElementById('st-agi').innerText = hunter.agi;
            document.getElementById('st-vit').innerText = hunter.vit;
            document.getElementById('st-int').innerText = hunter.int || 10;

            updateVitalsDisplay();

            const statPointsEl = document.getElementById('stat-points-available');
            if (statPointsEl) statPointsEl.innerText = hunter.statPoints || 0;

            const bossBonusEl = document.getElementById('stat-boss-bonus');
            if (bossBonusEl) bossBonusEl.innerText = getBossDamageBonusPercent().toFixed(1) + '%';

            document.getElementById('stat-disp-level').innerText = hunter.level;
            document.getElementById('stat-disp-rank').innerText = ranks[hunter.rankIndex];
            document.getElementById('stat-disp-name').innerText = hunter.name;
            const statDispTitleEl = document.getElementById('stat-disp-title');
            if (statDispTitleEl) statDispTitleEl.innerText = hunter.title || "Novice";

            document.getElementById('stat-total-completed').innerText = hunter.totalCompleted || 0;
            document.getElementById('stat-total-exp').innerText = hunter.totalExpGained || 0;
            document.getElementById('stat-total-gold').innerText = (hunter.totalGoldGained || 0) + " G";
            document.getElementById('stat-daily-completed').innerText = hunter.totalDailyCompleted || 0;
            renderEvaluation();
            refreshLabelSuggestions();

            const soundToggleEl = document.getElementById('sound-toggle');
            if (soundToggleEl) soundToggleEl.checked = hunter.soundEnabled !== false;

            const holidaySelectEl = document.getElementById('holiday-select');
            if (holidaySelectEl) holidaySelectEl.value = hunter.holiday || "None";

            const themeSelectEl = document.getElementById('theme-select');
            if (themeSelectEl) themeSelectEl.value = hunter.theme || "neon";

            const historyRetentionEl = document.getElementById('history-retention-select');
            if (historyRetentionEl) historyRetentionEl.value = String(hunter.historyRetentionHours || 0);

            renderBuffs();
            renderBoss();
            renderPrereqOptions();
            renderDashboardQuests();
            renderFinishedQuests();
            renderPendingGoals();
            renderHistoryQuests();
            renderAchievements();
            renderShop();
            renderInventory();
            renderEquipment();
            renderTitleOptions();
            renderDailyList();
            renderGoals();
        }

        // Evaluasi progress hunter murni pakai rumus matematika (rata-rata, persentase,
        // skor tertimbang) dari data quest selesai/gagal yang udah ada — TANPA AI sama sekali.
        function renderEvaluation() {
            const successRateEl = document.getElementById('eval-success-rate');
            const streakScoreEl = document.getElementById('eval-streak-score');
            const efficiencyEl = document.getElementById('eval-efficiency');
            const gradeEl = document.getElementById('eval-grade');
            const breakdownEl = document.getElementById('eval-label-breakdown');
            if (!successRateEl) return;

            const allResolved = [...finishedQuests, ...historyQuests];
            const totalCompleted = hunter.totalCompleted || 0;
            const totalFailed = historyQuests.filter(q => q.failed).length;
            const totalResolved = totalCompleted + totalFailed;

            if (totalResolved === 0) {
                successRateEl.innerText = '-';
                streakScoreEl.innerText = '-';
                efficiencyEl.innerText = '-';
                gradeEl.innerText = 'BELUM ADA DATA';
                breakdownEl.innerHTML = '';
                return;
            }

            // Success Rate: persentase quest selesai dari semua quest yang udah kelar (selesai + gagal), sepanjang waktu.
            const successRate = (totalCompleted / totalResolved) * 100;

            // Skor Konsistensi: streak aktif sekarang dibandingin ke target 30 hari beruntun, di-cap 100%.
            const streakScore = Math.min(100, ((hunter.streak || 0) / 30) * 100);

            // Efisiensi Waktu: rata-rata persentase waktu yang KEPAKE dari total waktu yang
            // dikasih sebelum quest itu diselesaikan (semakin kecil = semakin cepat kelar).
            // Cuma dihitung dari quest yang SELESAI (bukan gagal) & punya data waktu lengkap.
            const timedQuests = allResolved.filter(q => !q.failed && q.completedAt && q.deadline && q.durationHours);
            let efficiencyText = '-';
            if (timedQuests.length > 0) {
                const totalPct = timedQuests.reduce((sum, q) => {
                    const totalMs = q.durationHours * 60 * 60 * 1000;
                    const startMs = q.deadline - totalMs;
                    const usedMs = new Date(q.completedAt).getTime() - startMs;
                    const pct = totalMs > 0 ? Math.max(0, Math.min(100, (usedMs / totalMs) * 100)) : 0;
                    return sum + pct;
                }, 0);
                efficiencyText = (totalPct / timedQuests.length).toFixed(1) + '% dari waktu yang dikasih';
            }

            // Grade Keseluruhan: kombinasi tertimbang Success Rate (60%) + Skor Konsistensi (40%).
            const gradeScore = (successRate * 0.6) + (streakScore * 0.4);
            let gradeText = 'D - PERLU DITINGKATKAN';
            let gradeColor = 'var(--danger-glow)';
            if (gradeScore >= 90) { gradeText = 'S - LUAR BIASA'; gradeColor = 'var(--yellow-glow)'; }
            else if (gradeScore >= 75) { gradeText = 'A - SOLID'; gradeColor = 'var(--cyan-glow)'; }
            else if (gradeScore >= 60) { gradeText = 'B - LUMAYAN'; gradeColor = 'var(--label-glow)'; }
            else if (gradeScore >= 40) { gradeText = 'C - MASIH BISA NAIK'; gradeColor = 'var(--purple-glow)'; }

            successRateEl.innerText = `${successRate.toFixed(1)}% (${totalCompleted} selesai / ${totalFailed} gagal)`;
            streakScoreEl.innerText = `${streakScore.toFixed(1)}% (streak ${hunter.streak || 0} hari)`;
            efficiencyEl.innerText = efficiencyText;
            gradeEl.innerHTML = `<span style="color:${gradeColor};">${gradeText}</span> (skor ${gradeScore.toFixed(1)})`;

            // Breakdown per label: cuma label yang punya minimal 1 quest selesai/gagal.
            const labelStats = new Map();
            allResolved.forEach(q => {
                const lbl = (q.label || '').trim();
                if (!lbl) return;
                if (!labelStats.has(lbl)) labelStats.set(lbl, { done: 0, failed: 0 });
                const s = labelStats.get(lbl);
                if (q.failed) s.failed++; else s.done++;
            });

            if (labelStats.size === 0) {
                breakdownEl.innerHTML = '';
            } else {
                const rows = [...labelStats.entries()]
                    .sort((a, b) => (b[1].done + b[1].failed) - (a[1].done + a[1].failed))
                    .map(([lbl, s]) => {
                        const total = s.done + s.failed;
                        const rate = total > 0 ? ((s.done / total) * 100).toFixed(0) : 0;
                        return `<div>${lbl}: ${rate}% (${s.done} selesai / ${s.failed} gagal)</div>`;
                    }).join('');
                breakdownEl.innerHTML = `<div style="font-weight:bold; color:var(--text-main);">Per Label:</div>${rows}`;
            }
        }

        function renderBuffs() {
            const container = document.getElementById('buff-list');
            container.innerHTML = '';

            if (hunter.expMultiplier > 1) {
                container.innerHTML += `<div class="buff-badge">🧪 EXP x${hunter.expMultiplier} Active</div>`;
            }
            if (hunter.expBonusPercent > 0) {
                container.innerHTML += `<div class="buff-badge">🍀 EXP +${hunter.expBonusPercent}% Active</div>`;
            }
            if (hunter.goldBonusFlat > 0) {
                container.innerHTML += `<div class="buff-badge">🥇 +${hunter.goldBonusFlat} Gold Next Quest</div>`;
            }
            if (hunter.hardcoreSeal) {
                container.innerHTML += `<div class="buff-badge" style="border-color:var(--yellow-glow); color:var(--yellow-glow);">🔥 Hardcore Seal Active</div>`;
            }
        }

        function updateHunterName() {
            const newName = document.getElementById('setting-name-input').value.trim();
            if (!newName) return showToast("Nama tidak boleh kosong!");
            hunter.name = newName;
            saveData(); refreshUI();
            showToast("NAMA BERHASIL DIUBAH!");
        }

        /* --- STAT POINTS --- */
        // Dapat 1 stat point tiap naik 3 level (lihat checkLevelUp).
        // Tiap poin yang dipakein ke 1 stat nambah 0.5% dmg boss, maks 5% per stat.
        function spendStatPoint(statKey) {
            if (!hunter.statPoints || hunter.statPoints <= 0) {
                playErrorSound();
                return showToast("STAT POINT TIDAK CUKUP!");
            }
            if (!hunter.investedStats) hunter.investedStats = { str: 0, agi: 0, vit: 0, int: 0 };

            hunter.statPoints -= 1;
            hunter.investedStats[statKey] = (hunter.investedStats[statKey] || 0) + 1;
            hunter[statKey] = (hunter[statKey] || 10) + 1;

            saveData(); refreshUI();
            playCoinSound();
            showToast(`+1 ${statKey.toUpperCase()}! (STAT POINT DIPAKAI)`);
        }

        /* --- DASHBOARD QUEST (OTOMATIS SORT A-Z & PRIORITAS DAILY) --- */
        function renderDashboardQuests() {
            const container = document.getElementById('dash-quest-list');
            container.innerHTML = '';

            // Clone array quest
            let displayQuests = [...quests];

            // Direct Sort: Prioritaskan Daily Quest, lalu urutkan A-Z secara default
            displayQuests.sort((a, b) => {
                if (a.isDaily && !b.isDaily) return -1;
                if (!a.isDaily && b.isDaily) return 1;
                return a.title.localeCompare(b.title);
            });

            if (displayQuests.length === 0) {
                container.innerHTML = `<div style="text-align:center; color:var(--text-muted); font-size:0.8rem; margin-top:20px;">TIDAK ADA QUEST AKTIF</div>`;
                return;
            }

            // Kelompokkan quest yang punya label sama (dibandingkan tanpa peduli huruf
            // besar/kecil), sambil tetap mempertahankan posisi kemunculan pertama label
            // tersebut di urutan yang udah disortir di atas. Quest tanpa label dirender
            // sendiri-sendiri seperti biasa (gak masuk grup manapun).
            const labelGroups = new Map(); // normalizedLabel -> { displayLabel, items: [] }
            const renderSequence = []; // array of quest (unlabeled) atau string normalizedLabel (marker grup)

            displayQuests.forEach(q => {
                const norm = (q.label || '').trim().toLowerCase();
                if (!norm) {
                    renderSequence.push(q);
                    return;
                }
                if (!labelGroups.has(norm)) {
                    labelGroups.set(norm, { displayLabel: q.label.trim(), items: [] });
                    renderSequence.push(norm);
                }
                labelGroups.get(norm).items.push(q);
            });

            renderSequence.forEach(entry => {
                if (typeof entry === 'string') {
                    const group = labelGroups.get(entry);
                    if (group.items.length < 2) {
                        // Cuma 1 quest yang pake label ini, gak usah dianggap "kelompok".
                        container.appendChild(buildQuestBoxElement(group.items[0]));
                        return;
                    }
                    const groupWrap = document.createElement('div');
                    groupWrap.className = 'quest-label-group';
                    const header = document.createElement('div');
                    header.className = 'quest-label-header';
                    header.innerHTML = `${group.displayLabel} <span style="color:var(--text-muted); font-weight:600; text-transform:none;">(${group.items.length})</span>`;
                    groupWrap.appendChild(header);
                    group.items.forEach(q => groupWrap.appendChild(buildQuestBoxElement(q)));
                    container.appendChild(groupWrap);
                } else {
                    container.appendChild(buildQuestBoxElement(entry));
                }
            });
        }

        // Bikin 1 elemen quest-box lengkap (swipe-wrap + hint gagal/edit + isinya).
        // Dipisah dari renderDashboardQuests biar bisa dipakai ulang buat quest yang
        // dikelompokkan (dalam quest-label-group) maupun yang berdiri sendiri.
        function buildQuestBoxElement(q) {
            const isLocked = q.unlocked === false;

            const wrap = document.createElement('div');
            wrap.className = 'quest-swipe-wrap';

            const hint = document.createElement('div');
            hint.className = 'quest-fail-hint';
            hint.innerHTML = '✕ GAGAL (-2 Gold)';
            wrap.appendChild(hint);

            const editHint = document.createElement('div');
            editHint.className = 'quest-edit-hint';
            editHint.innerHTML = '✏️ EDIT NAMA';
            wrap.appendChild(editHint);

            const box = document.createElement('div');
            box.className = 'quest-box' + (q.isDaily ? ' is-daily' : '') + (q.isProgressive ? ' is-progressive' : '') + (isLocked ? ' is-locked' : '');
            box.innerHTML = `
                <div class="quest-info">
                    <div class="quest-title-row">
                        ${q.autoComplete ? '<span class="auto-complete-dot" title="Auto-selesai saat waktu habis"></span>' : ''}
                        <div class="quest-name">${q.title}</div>
                        ${q.isDaily ? '<span class="daily-badge">DAILY QUEST</span>' : ''}
                        ${q.label ? `<span class="daily-badge" style="border-color:var(--label-glow); color:var(--label-glow);">${q.label}</span>` : ''}
                        ${isLocked ? '<span class="daily-badge" style="border-color:var(--danger-glow); color:var(--danger-glow);">🔒 TERKUNCI</span>' : ''}
                        ${(!isLocked && q.isProgressive) ? `<span class="daily-badge" style="border-color:var(--cyan-glow); color:var(--cyan-glow);">${q.current}/${q.target}</span>` : ''}
                    </div>
                    ${isLocked
                        ? `<div class="quest-meta">+${q.exp} EXP | ${q.diff} | Butuh "${q.requiresQuestTitle}" selesai dulu</div>`
                        : `<div class="quest-meta">+${q.exp} EXP | ${q.diff} | ⏱ <span id="timer-${q.id}">--:--:--</span></div>`
                    }
                </div>
            `;

            if (!isLocked) box.style.cursor = 'pointer';

            attachQuestGestures(box, q.id, isLocked, q.isProgressive, editHint, hint);

            wrap.appendChild(box);
            return wrap;
        }


        // Satu handler gesture buat semua interaksi quest-box:
        // - tap 2x (non-progressive) / tap 1x (progressive) -> selesai/nambah progress
        // - tahan 5 detik -> hapus quest (tetap jalan walau quest lagi terkunci)
        // - swipe ke kanan ngelewatin ambang batas -> quest GAGAL (-2 Gold)
        // - swipe ke kiri ngelewatin ambang batas -> buka modal EDIT NAMA QUEST
        function attachQuestGestures(el, questId, isLocked, isProgressive, editHintEl, failHintEl) {
            const HOLD_MS = 5000;
            const SWIPE_THRESHOLD = 90;
            const DETAIL_SWIPE_THRESHOLD = 220; // geser kiri SAMPAI UJUNG buat buka detail/catatan
            const MOVE_TOLERANCE = 10;
            const DOUBLE_TAP_MS = 400;

            let startX = 0, startY = 0, dragX = 0;
            let holdTimer = null;
            let holdTriggered = false;
            let isSwiping = false;
            let lastTap = 0;

            function getIndex() {
                return quests.findIndex(item => item.id === questId);
            }

            function startHold() {
                el.classList.add('holding-delete');
                holdTriggered = false;
                holdTimer = setTimeout(() => {
                    holdTriggered = true;
                    const idx = getIndex();
                    if (idx !== -1) deleteActiveQuest(idx);
                }, HOLD_MS);
            }
            function cancelHold() {
                clearTimeout(holdTimer);
                el.classList.remove('holding-delete');
            }
            function resetGestureVisual() {
                el.style.transform = '';
                el.style.opacity = '';
                if (editHintEl) {
                    editHintEl.style.opacity = '0';
                    editHintEl.style.color = '';
                    editHintEl.style.borderColor = '';
                    editHintEl.innerHTML = '✏️ EDIT NAMA';
                }
                if (failHintEl) failHintEl.style.opacity = '0';
            }

            el.addEventListener('pointerdown', (e) => {
                startX = e.clientX;
                startY = e.clientY;
                dragX = 0;
                isSwiping = false;
                startHold();
            });

            el.addEventListener('pointermove', (e) => {
                const moveX = e.clientX - startX;
                const moveY = e.clientY - startY;

                if (!isSwiping) {
                    if (Math.abs(moveX) > MOVE_TOLERANCE && Math.abs(moveX) > Math.abs(moveY)) {
                        isSwiping = true;
                        cancelHold();
                    }
                }

                if (isSwiping) {
                    dragX = moveX;
                    el.style.transform = `translateX(${dragX}px)`;
                    el.style.opacity = String(Math.max(0.35, 1 - Math.abs(dragX) / 320));
                    if (editHintEl) {
                        if (dragX < 0) {
                            const pastDetail = dragX <= -DETAIL_SWIPE_THRESHOLD;
                            editHintEl.innerHTML = pastDetail ? '📝 LEPAS UNTUK DETAIL & CATATAN' : '✏️ EDIT NAMA';
                            editHintEl.style.color = pastDetail ? 'var(--yellow-glow)' : '';
                            editHintEl.style.borderColor = pastDetail ? 'var(--yellow-glow)' : '';
                            editHintEl.style.opacity = String(Math.min(1, Math.abs(dragX) / SWIPE_THRESHOLD));
                        } else {
                            editHintEl.style.opacity = '0';
                        }
                    }
                    if (failHintEl) failHintEl.style.opacity = dragX > 0 ? String(Math.min(1, dragX / SWIPE_THRESHOLD)) : '0';
                }
            });

            function endGesture() {
                cancelHold();

                if (isSwiping) {
                    if (dragX > SWIPE_THRESHOLD && !isLocked) {
                        const idx = getIndex();
                        resetGestureVisual();
                        isSwiping = false;
                        if (idx !== -1) failQuest(idx);
                        return;
                    } else if (dragX <= -DETAIL_SWIPE_THRESHOLD) {
                        const idx = getIndex();
                        resetGestureVisual();
                        isSwiping = false;
                        if (idx !== -1) openQuestDetailModal(idx);
                        return;
                    } else if (dragX < -SWIPE_THRESHOLD) {
                        const idx = getIndex();
                        resetGestureVisual();
                        isSwiping = false;
                        if (idx !== -1) openEditQuestModal(idx);
                        return;
                    } else {
                        resetGestureVisual();
                    }
                    isSwiping = false;
                    return;
                }

                if (holdTriggered) return;
                if (isLocked) return;

                if (isProgressive) {
                    const idx = getIndex();
                    if (idx !== -1) incrementProgress(idx);
                } else {
                    const now = Date.now();
                    if (now - lastTap < DOUBLE_TAP_MS) {
                        lastTap = 0;
                        const idx = getIndex();
                        if (idx !== -1) markAsFinished(idx);
                    } else {
                        lastTap = now;
                    }
                }
            }

            function cancelGesture() {
                cancelHold();
                if (isSwiping) resetGestureVisual();
                isSwiping = false;
            }

            el.addEventListener('pointerup', endGesture);
            el.addEventListener('pointerleave', cancelGesture);
            el.addEventListener('pointercancel', cancelGesture);
        }

        // Hapus quest sekarang 2 langkah: pertama dipindah ke tab FINISHED
        // sebagai "menunggu konfirmasi hapus" (bisa dibatalin), baru beneran
        // hilang kalau user konfirmasi lewat cancelPendingDelete/confirmPendingDelete.
        function deleteActiveQuest(index) {
            const q = quests[index];
            if (!q) return;

            if (isHpDepleted()) {
                playErrorSound();
                showToast("HP HABIS! Tidak bisa menghapus quest sampai HP pulih.");
                return;
            }

            quests.splice(index, 1);
            finishedQuests.push({ ...q, pendingDelete: true });

            saveData(); refreshUI();
            playDeleteSound();
            showToast(`QUEST "${q.title}" DIPINDAH KE TAB FINISHED, KONFIRMASI DULU BUAT HAPUS!`);
        }

        function cancelPendingDelete(index) {
            const q = finishedQuests[index];
            if (!q || !q.pendingDelete) return;
            finishedQuests.splice(index, 1);

            const { pendingDelete, ...restoredQuest } = q;
            quests.push(restoredQuest);

            saveData(); refreshUI();
            showToast(`PENGHAPUSAN "${q.title}" DIBATALKAN, QUEST DIKEMBALIKAN!`);
        }

        function confirmPendingDelete(index) {
            const q = finishedQuests[index];
            if (!q || !q.pendingDelete) return;
            finishedQuests.splice(index, 1);

            // FIX: kalau ada quest lain yang mensyaratkan quest ini selesai dulu,
            // dan quest ini malah dihapus (bukan diselesaikan), quest yang terkunci
            // tadinya akan terkunci SELAMANYA (referensi prasyaratnya jadi nyangkut/dangling).
            // Sekarang otomatis dibuka begitu prasyaratnya dihapus permanen.
            quests.forEach(dep => {
                if (dep.requiresQuestId === q.id && dep.unlocked === false) {
                    dep.unlocked = true;
                    dep.requiresQuestId = null;
                    dep.requiresQuestTitle = null;
                    dep.deadline = Date.now() + ((dep.durationHours || 24) * 60 * 60 * 1000);
                    showToast(`🔓 QUEST "${dep.title}" TERBUKA (prasyarat dihapus)!`);
                }
            });

            saveData(); refreshUI();
            playDeleteSound();
            showToast(`QUEST "${q.title}" DIHAPUS PERMANEN!`);
        }


        // Quest GAGAL: dipicu manual (swipe kanan) ATAU otomatis kalau deadline
        // kelewat. Dua-duanya dapet perlakuan sama: -2 Gold & masuk History
        // dengan label GAGAL (gak lewat tab FINISHED/verifikasi).
        function failQuest(index) {
            const qCheck = quests[index];
            if (!qCheck) return;

            if (isHpDepleted()) {
                playErrorSound();
                showToast("HP HABIS! Tidak bisa menggagalkan quest sampai HP pulih.");
                return;
            }

            const q = quests.splice(index, 1)[0];
            if (!q) return;

            hunter.gold = Math.max(0, hunter.gold - 2);
            hunter.hp = Math.max(0, (hunter.hp || 0) - 20);

            // Quest lain yang butuh quest ini selesai duluan tetap terkunci
            // (karena ini gagal, bukan selesai) kecuali prasyaratnya ikut kehapus
            // gara-gara quest ini dihapus dari array — itu udah ditangani terpisah
            // di deleteActiveQuest. Di sini quest gagal, jadi dependennya tetap terkunci.

            historyQuests.unshift({
                ...q,
                failed: true,
                gainedExp: 0,
                gainedGold: -2,
                completedAt: new Date().toISOString()
            });

            saveData(); refreshUI();
            playErrorSound();
            showToast(`QUEST "${q.title}" GAGAL! (-2 Gold, -20 HP)`);
        }

        setInterval(() => {
            const now = Date.now();

            regenVitals();

            // Cek deadline duluan (loop mundur biar aman pas ada yang di-splice).
            // Quest yang ditandai autoComplete diselesaikan sendiri (bukan gagal) begitu waktunya habis.
            // Kalau quest itu juga SELESAI SECARA BERTAHAP: tiap kali waktu habis cuma nambah +1
            // progress lalu waktu di-reset lagi (nunggu siklus berikutnya), sampai progress = target,
            // baru beneran diselesaikan (dapet EXP/Gold). Sisanya (non-autoComplete) tetap GAGAL seperti biasa.
            for (let i = quests.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
                const q = quests[i];
                if (q.unlocked === false || !q.deadline) continue;
                if (q.deadline - now <= 0) {
                    if (q.autoComplete) {
                        if (q.isProgressive) {
                            q.current = Math.min(q.target, (q.current || 0) + 1);
                            if (q.current >= q.target) {
                                markAsFinished(i, true);
                            } else {
                                q.deadline = Date.now() + ((q.durationHours || 24) * 60 * 60 * 1000);
                                q.notifiedSoon = false;
                                saveData();
                                refreshUI();
                                showToast(`⏳ "${q.title}" +1 PROGRESS OTOMATIS! (${q.current}/${q.target}) — waktu di-reset.`);
                                sendNotification("⏳ AUTO PROGRESS", `"${q.title}" nambah progress jadi ${q.current}/${q.target}, waktu direset buat siklus berikutnya.`);
                            }
                        } else {
                            markAsFinished(i, true);
                        }
                    } else {
                        failQuest(i);
                    }
                }
            }

            quests.forEach(q => {
                const timerEl = document.getElementById(`timer-${q.id}`);
                if (timerEl && q.deadline) {
                    const diff = q.deadline - now;
                    if (diff <= 30 * 60 * 1000 && diff > 0 && !q.notifiedSoon) {
                        q.notifiedSoon = true;
                        const mLeft = Math.ceil(diff / (1000 * 60));
                        sendNotification("⏰ QUEST HAMPIR DEADLINE", `"${q.title}" tersisa ${mLeft} menit lagi!`);
                    }
                    const h = Math.floor(diff / (1000 * 60 * 60));
                    const m = Math.floor((diff % (1000 * 60 * 60)) / (1000 * 60));
                    const s = Math.floor((diff % (1000 * 60)) / 1000);
                    timerEl.innerText = `${h}j ${m}m ${s}d`;
                }
            });
        }, 1000);

        setInterval(() => { checkAutoGenerateDaily(); checkStreakReset(); purgeOldHistory(); checkGoalsDeadline(); }, 60 * 1000);

        function toggleProgressiveInput() {
            const checked = document.getElementById('q-progressive').checked;
            document.getElementById('q-target-group').style.display = checked ? 'flex' : 'none';
        }

        function toggleCustomTimeInput() {
            const checked = document.getElementById('q-custom-time').checked;
            document.getElementById('q-custom-time-group').style.display = checked ? 'flex' : 'none';
        }

        function addNewQuest() {
            if (isHpDepleted()) {
                playErrorSound();
                showToast("HP HABIS! Tidak bisa menambah quest baru sampai HP pulih.");
                return;
            }

            if (quests.length >= hunter.limit) {
                playErrorSound();
                showToast("LIMIT QUEST TERCAPAI (" + hunter.limit + ")");
                return;
            }

            const title = document.getElementById('q-title').value.trim();
            const label = document.getElementById('q-label').value.trim();
            const diff = document.getElementById('q-diff').value;
            const isProgressive = document.getElementById('q-progressive').checked;
            const target = parseInt(document.getElementById('q-target').value) || 100;
            const prereqId = document.getElementById('q-prereq').value;
            const useCustomTime = document.getElementById('q-custom-time').checked;
            const customH = parseInt(document.getElementById('q-custom-h').value) || 0;
            const customM = parseInt(document.getElementById('q-custom-m').value) || 0;
            const customS = parseInt(document.getElementById('q-custom-s').value) || 0;
            const customHours = customH + (customM / 60) + (customS / 3600);
            const isAutoComplete = document.getElementById('q-auto-complete').checked;

            if (!title) { playErrorSound(); return showToast("Masukkan nama quest!"); }
            if (isProgressive && target < 1) { playErrorSound(); return showToast("Target harus minimal 1!"); }
            if (useCustomTime && customHours <= 0) {
                playErrorSound();
                return showToast("Isi batas waktu custom (jam/menit/detik) yang valid dulu!");
            }

            function finalizeAddQuest() {
                let hours = 24;
                let exp = 150;
                if (diff === 'EASY') { hours = 72; exp = 50; }
                else if (diff === 'NORMAL') { hours = 24; exp = 150; }
                else if (diff === 'HARD') { hours = 10; exp = 300; }

                // Waktu custom sepenuhnya GANTIKAN waktu default difficulty di atas
                // (EXP/Gold tetap ngikut difficulty seperti biasa, cuma durasinya yang beda).
                if (useCustomTime) hours = customHours;

                const prereqQuest = prereqId ? quests.find(qq => String(qq.id) === String(prereqId)) : null;
                const isLocked = !!prereqQuest;

                const newQ = {
                    id: Date.now(),
                    title: title,
                    label: label,
                    exp: exp,
                    diff: diff,
                    durationHours: hours,
                    deadline: isLocked ? null : (Date.now() + (hours * 60 * 60 * 1000)),
                    isDaily: false,
                    isProgressive: isProgressive,
                    current: isProgressive ? 0 : undefined,
                    target: isProgressive ? target : undefined,
                    requiresQuestId: prereqQuest ? prereqQuest.id : null,
                    requiresQuestTitle: prereqQuest ? prereqQuest.title : null,
                    unlocked: !isLocked,
                    useCustomTime: useCustomTime,
                    autoComplete: isAutoComplete
                };

                quests.push(newQ);
                document.getElementById('q-title').value = '';
                document.getElementById('q-label').value = '';
                document.getElementById('q-progressive').checked = false;
                document.getElementById('q-target-group').style.display = 'none';
                document.getElementById('q-prereq').value = '';
                document.getElementById('q-custom-time').checked = false;
                document.getElementById('q-custom-h').value = '';
                document.getElementById('q-custom-m').value = '';
                document.getElementById('q-custom-s').value = '';
                document.getElementById('q-custom-time-group').style.display = 'none';
                document.getElementById('q-auto-complete').checked = false;
                saveData(); refreshUI();
                playQuestAddedSound();
                showToast(isLocked ? `QUEST DITAMBAHKAN (🔒 terkunci sampai "${prereqQuest.title}" selesai)` : "QUEST DITAMBAHKAN!");
            }

            if (isAutoComplete) {
                showConfirmModal(`Apakah "${title}" ini quest yang bakal SELESAI SENDIRI kalau waktunya habis (bukan dianggap GAGAL)?`, finalizeAddQuest);
            } else {
                finalizeAddQuest();
            }
        }

        function renderPrereqOptions() {
            const sel = document.getElementById('q-prereq');
            if (!sel) return;
            const currentVal = sel.value;
            sel.innerHTML = '<option value="">Tidak ada / Bebas langsung dikerjain</option>';
            quests.forEach(q => {
                const opt = document.createElement('option');
                opt.value = q.id;
                opt.innerText = q.title + (q.unlocked === false ? ' (🔒 masih terkunci)' : '');
                sel.appendChild(opt);
            });
            if ([...sel.options].some(o => o.value === currentVal)) sel.value = currentVal;
        }

        function incrementProgress(index) {
            const q = quests[index];
            if (!q || !q.isProgressive) return;

            q.current = Math.min(q.target, (q.current || 0) + 1);

            if (q.current >= q.target) {
                // markAsFinished bisa nolak (HP habis / fatigue / MP kurang) —
                // simpan progress-nya dulu biar gak hilang meski gagal clear.
                saveData();
                refreshUI();
                markAsFinished(index);
            } else {
                saveData();
                refreshUI();
            }
        }

        function getDiffConfig(diff) {
            if (diff === 'EASY') return { exp: 50, hours: 72 };
            if (diff === 'HARD') return { exp: 300, hours: 10 };
            return { exp: 150, hours: 24 };
        }

        function toggleSysProgressiveInput() {
            const checked = document.getElementById('sys-q-progressive').checked;
            document.getElementById('sys-q-target-group').style.display = checked ? 'flex' : 'none';
        }

        function toggleSysCustomTimeInput() {
            const checked = document.getElementById('sys-q-custom-time').checked;
            document.getElementById('sys-q-custom-time-group').style.display = checked ? 'flex' : 'none';
        }

        function addDailyPreset() {
            const selectedDay = document.getElementById('sys-day-select').value;
            const title = document.getElementById('sys-q-input').value.trim();
            const label = document.getElementById('sys-q-label').value.trim();
            const diff = document.getElementById('sys-q-diff').value;
            const isProgressive = document.getElementById('sys-q-progressive').checked;
            const target = parseInt(document.getElementById('sys-q-target').value) || 100;
            const useCustomTime = document.getElementById('sys-q-custom-time').checked;
            const customH = parseInt(document.getElementById('sys-q-custom-h').value) || 0;
            const customM = parseInt(document.getElementById('sys-q-custom-m').value) || 0;
            const customS = parseInt(document.getElementById('sys-q-custom-s').value) || 0;
            const customHours = customH + (customM / 60) + (customS / 3600);
            const isAutoComplete = document.getElementById('sys-q-auto-complete').checked;

            if (!title) { playErrorSound(); return showToast("Masukkan nama quest harian!"); }
            if (isProgressive && target < 1) { playErrorSound(); return showToast("Target harus minimal 1!"); }
            if (useCustomTime && customHours <= 0) {
                playErrorSound();
                return showToast("Isi batas waktu custom (jam/menit/detik) yang valid dulu!");
            }
            if (!dailyPresets[selectedDay]) dailyPresets[selectedDay] = [];

            function finalizeAddDailyPreset() {
                dailyPresets[selectedDay].push({
                    id: Date.now(),
                    title: title,
                    label: label,
                    diff: diff,
                    isProgressive: isProgressive,
                    target: isProgressive ? target : undefined,
                    useCustomTime: useCustomTime,
                    customHours: useCustomTime ? customHours : undefined,
                    autoComplete: isAutoComplete
                });

                document.getElementById('sys-q-input').value = '';
                document.getElementById('sys-q-label').value = '';
                document.getElementById('sys-q-progressive').checked = false;
                document.getElementById('sys-q-target-group').style.display = 'none';
                document.getElementById('sys-q-custom-time').checked = false;
                document.getElementById('sys-q-custom-h').value = '';
                document.getElementById('sys-q-custom-m').value = '';
                document.getElementById('sys-q-custom-s').value = '';
                document.getElementById('sys-q-custom-time-group').style.display = 'none';
                document.getElementById('sys-q-auto-complete').checked = false;
                saveData(); renderDailyList();
                playQuestAddedSound();
                showToast(`DAILY QUEST HARI ${selectedDay.toUpperCase()} DISIMPAN!`);

                const daysName = ["Minggu", "Senin", "Selasa", "Rabu", "Kamis", "Jumat", "Sabtu"];
                if (selectedDay === daysName[new Date().getDay()]) generateDailyNow();
            }

            if (isAutoComplete) {
                showConfirmModal(`Apakah "${title}" ini quest yang bakal SELESAI SENDIRI kalau waktunya habis (bukan dianggap GAGAL)?`, finalizeAddDailyPreset);
            } else {
                finalizeAddDailyPreset();
            }
        }

        function removeDailyPreset(day, id) {
            dailyPresets[day] = dailyPresets[day].filter(item => item.id !== id);
            saveData(); renderDailyList();
            showToast("DAILY QUEST DIHAPUS!");
        }

        function renderDailyList() {
            const selectedDay = document.getElementById('sys-day-select').value;
            const container = document.getElementById('daily-preset-list');
            container.innerHTML = '';

            const list = dailyPresets[selectedDay] || [];
            if (list.length === 0) {
                container.innerHTML = `<div style="font-size:0.7rem; color:var(--text-muted);">Belum ada daily quest untuk hari ${selectedDay}.</div>`;
                return;
            }

            list.forEach(item => {
                const row = document.createElement('div');
                row.className = 'daily-item';
                const cfg = getDiffConfig(item.diff);
                const extraTags = `${item.label ? ` | ${item.label}` : ''}${item.isProgressive ? ` | Target ${item.target}` : ''}${item.useCustomTime ? ' | ⚙ Waktu Custom' : ''}${item.autoComplete ? ' | ⏳ Auto-Selesai' : ''}`;
                row.innerHTML = `
                    <div style="font-size:0.75rem; color:#fff;">${item.title} <span style="color:var(--cyan-glow); font-size:0.65rem;">(${item.diff || 'NORMAL'} | +${cfg.exp} EXP${extraTags})</span></div>
                    <button class="btn-neon btn-neon-danger" style="padding:2px 6px; font-size:0.6rem;" onclick="removeDailyPreset('${selectedDay}', ${item.id})">HAPUS</button>
                `;
                container.appendChild(row);
            });
        }

        /* --- WEEKLY BOSS BATTLE --- */
        function saveBossData() {
            localStorage.setItem('rpg_boss', JSON.stringify(bossState));
        }

        // Pilih 1 variasi boss secara acak berdasarkan bobot (weight) yang di-set di bossVariants.
        function pickBossVariant() {
            const totalWeight = bossVariants.reduce((sum, v) => sum + v.weight, 0);
            let roll = Math.random() * totalWeight;
            for (const v of bossVariants) {
                if (roll < v.weight) return v;
                roll -= v.weight;
            }
            return bossVariants[0];
        }

        function spawnNewBoss() {
            const now = Date.now();
            const variant = pickBossVariant();
            bossState = {
                name: variant.name,
                icon: variant.icon,
                maxHp: variant.maxHp,
                currentHp: variant.maxHp,
                goldReward: variant.goldReward,
                startDate: now,
                deadline: now + (7 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000),
                defeated: false
            };
            saveBossData();
        }

        // Dipanggil tiap kali app dibuka & tiap 1 menit sekali.
        // Boss pertama muncul begitu fitur ini pertama kali dijalankan.
        // Selanjutnya, boss otomatis diganti tiap 7 hari (1x seminggu),
        // baik dia berhasil dikalahkan atau waktunya habis duluan.
        function checkBossWeeklyReset() {
            if (!bossState) {
                spawnNewBoss();
                showToast(`${bossState.icon} ${bossState.name} MUNCUL! HP ${bossState.maxHp}`);
                sendNotification("👹 BOSS MUNCUL!", `${bossState.name} muncul dengan HP ${bossState.maxHp}. Selesaikan quest buat ngalahin dia sebelum 7 hari!`);
                return;
            }

            if (Date.now() >= bossState.deadline) {
                const wasDefeated = bossState.defeated;
                spawnNewBoss();
                if (wasDefeated) {
                    showToast(`${bossState.icon} ${bossState.name} MUNCUL MINGGU INI!`);
                } else {
                    showToast(`⌛ WAKTU HABIS! ${bossState.icon} ${bossState.name} MUNCUL!`);
                }
                sendNotification("👹 BOSS BARU!", `${bossState.name} muncul dengan HP ${bossState.maxHp}. Selesaikan quest buat ngalahin dia sebelum 7 hari!`);
            }
        }

        // Total bonus stat dari SEMUA item yang lagi dipasang di slot equipment.
        function getEquipmentStatBonus(statKey) {
            if (!hunter.equipped) return 0;
            let total = 0;
            Object.values(hunter.equipped).forEach(itemId => {
                if (!itemId) return;
                const def = shopCatalog.find(i => i.id === itemId);
                if (def && def.bonus && def.bonus[statKey]) total += def.bonus[statKey];
            });
            return total;
        }

        // Tiap poin stat yang diinvest ke STR lewat STAT POINT ATAU dari bonus
        // STR equipment yang lagi dipasang nambah 0.5% dmg boss, dibatasi
        // maksimal 10% total. AGI/VIT/INT gak lagi nambah dmg boss (VIT -> HP,
        // AGI/INT -> MP & ambang Fatigue) — equipment AGI/VIT/INT tetap ngefek
        // lewat situ karena bonusnya langsung nambah hunter.agi/vit/int mentah.
        function getBossDamageBonusPercent() {
            const investedStr = (hunter.investedStats && hunter.investedStats.str) || 0;
            const equipStr = getEquipmentStatBonus('str');
            const perPointPercent = 0.5;
            const capPercent = 10;
            return Math.min(capPercent, (investedStr + equipStr) * perPointPercent);
        }

        // 1 EXP quest yang diselesaikan = 1 DMG ke boss.
        // FIX: sebelumnya dmg yang dicatat buat UNDO gak ikut bonus % dari stat
        // point, jadi kalau di-UNDO, HP boss yang balik lebih sedikit dari yang
        // kepotong beneran. Sekarang damageBoss() balikin dmg final (udah + bonus)
        // biar yang dicatat & yang di-UNDO nanti sama persis.
        function damageBoss(amount) {
            if (!bossState || bossState.defeated) return 0;
            if (Date.now() >= bossState.deadline) return 0;

            let dmg = Math.floor(amount / 10);
            if (dmg <= 0) return 0;

            const bonusPercent = getBossDamageBonusPercent();
            if (bonusPercent > 0) dmg = Math.round(dmg * (1 + bonusPercent / 100));

            bossState.currentHp = Math.max(0, bossState.currentHp - dmg);

            if (bossState.currentHp <= 0) {
                bossState.defeated = true;
                const reward = bossState.goldReward || 50;
                hunter.gold += reward;
                hunter.totalBossesDefeated = (hunter.totalBossesDefeated || 0) + 1;
                showToast(`${bossState.icon} 💥 ${bossState.name} DIKALAHKAN! +${reward} GOLD BONUS!`);
                sendNotification("💥 BOSS DIKALAHKAN!", `${hunter.name} berhasil mengalahkan ${bossState.name}! +${reward} Gold bonus.`);
                playBossDefeatSound();
                checkBossAchievements();
                saveData();
            }
            saveBossData();
            return dmg;
        }

        function renderBoss() {
            const arena = document.getElementById('boss-arena');
            if (!arena || !bossState) return;

            const now = Date.now();
            const msLeft = Math.max(0, bossState.deadline - now);
            const daysLeft = Math.floor(msLeft / (24 * 60 * 60 * 1000));
            const hoursLeft = Math.floor((msLeft % (24 * 60 * 60 * 1000)) / (60 * 60 * 1000));
            const hpPercent = (bossState.currentHp / bossState.maxHp) * 100;
            const isCritical = hpPercent <= 20 && !bossState.defeated;

            arena.classList.toggle('is-defeated', bossState.defeated);

            document.getElementById('boss-name-text').innerText = bossState.defeated ? "✅ BOSS TUMBANG" : `⚠ ${bossState.name || 'WEEKLY BOSS'}`;
            document.getElementById('boss-timer').innerText = bossState.defeated
                ? "Menunggu boss baru minggu depan..."
                : `⏳ Sisa ${daysLeft}h ${hoursLeft}j`;

            document.getElementById('boss-hp-fill').style.width = hpPercent + '%';
            document.getElementById('boss-hp-text').innerText = bossState.defeated
                ? `0 / ${bossState.maxHp} HP — DIKALAHKAN!`
                : `${bossState.currentHp} / ${bossState.maxHp} HP`;

            const sprite = document.getElementById('boss-sprite');
            sprite.classList.toggle('critical', isCritical);
            sprite.classList.toggle('defeated-sprite', bossState.defeated);
            sprite.innerText = bossState.defeated ? '💀' : (bossState.icon || '👹');
        }

        setInterval(() => {
            checkBossWeeklyReset();
            renderBoss();
        }, 60 * 1000);

        function checkAutoGenerateDaily() {
            const daysName = ["Minggu", "Senin", "Selasa", "Rabu", "Kamis", "Jumat", "Sabtu"];
            const todayName = daysName[new Date().getDay()];
            const todayStr = new Date().toDateString();

            if (hunter.lastDailyGenerated === todayStr) return;

            if (hunter.holiday === todayName) {
                showToast("HARI INI ADALAH HARI LIBUR HUNTER!");
                hunter.lastDailyGenerated = todayStr;
                saveData(); return;
            }

            const todayList = dailyPresets[todayName] || [];
            let addedCount = 0;

            todayList.forEach(item => {
                if (quests.length < hunter.limit) {
                    const cfg = getDiffConfig(item.diff);
                    const hours = (item.useCustomTime && item.customHours > 0) ? item.customHours : cfg.hours;
                    quests.push({
                        id: Date.now() + Math.random(),
                        title: item.title,
                        label: item.label || '',
                        exp: cfg.exp,
                        diff: item.diff || "NORMAL",
                        durationHours: hours,
                        deadline: Date.now() + (hours * 60 * 60 * 1000),
                        isDaily: true,
                        isProgressive: item.isProgressive || false,
                        current: item.isProgressive ? 0 : undefined,
                        target: item.isProgressive ? item.target : undefined,
                        useCustomTime: item.useCustomTime || false,
                        autoComplete: item.autoComplete || false
                    });
                    addedCount++;
                }
            });

            hunter.lastDailyGenerated = todayStr;
            saveData();
            if (addedCount > 0) {
                showToast(`${addedCount} DAILY QUEST HARI ${todayName.toUpperCase()} MUNCUL!`);
                sendNotification("📋 DAILY QUEST BARU", `${addedCount} daily quest hari ${todayName} sudah tersedia!`);
                refreshUI();
            }
        }

        function generateDailyNow() {
            const selectedDay = document.getElementById('sys-day-select').value;
            const list = dailyPresets[selectedDay] || [];
            if (list.length === 0) return showToast(`Belum ada daily quest untuk hari ${selectedDay}.`);

            let added = 0;
            list.forEach(item => {
                const alreadyActive = quests.some(q => q.isDaily && q.title === item.title);
                if (!alreadyActive && quests.length < hunter.limit) {
                    const cfg = getDiffConfig(item.diff);
                    const hours = (item.useCustomTime && item.customHours > 0) ? item.customHours : cfg.hours;
                    quests.push({
                        id: Date.now() + Math.random(),
                        title: item.title,
                        label: item.label || '',
                        exp: cfg.exp,
                        diff: item.diff || "NORMAL",
                        durationHours: hours,
                        deadline: Date.now() + (hours * 60 * 60 * 1000),
                        isDaily: true,
                        isProgressive: item.isProgressive || false,
                        current: item.isProgressive ? 0 : undefined,
                        target: item.isProgressive ? item.target : undefined,
                        useCustomTime: item.useCustomTime || false,
                        autoComplete: item.autoComplete || false
                    });
                    added++;
                }
            });

            saveData(); refreshUI();
            if (added > 0) showToast(`${added} DAILY QUEST TAMPIL DI MENU UTAMA!`);
            else showToast(`Quest sudah aktif atau slot quest penuh.`);
        }

        /* --- MENYELESAIKAN QUEST --- */
        function markAsFinished(index, force = false) {
            const qCheck = quests[index];
            if (!qCheck) return;

            if (!force) {
                if (isHpDepleted()) {
                    playErrorSound();
                    showToast("HP HABIS! Tidak bisa clear quest sampai HP pulih.");
                    return;
                }

                if (isFatigued()) {
                    playErrorSound();
                    showToast(`⚡ FATIGUE! Tunggu ${fatigueRemainingText()} sebelum bisa clear quest lagi.`);
                    return;
                }
            }

            const mpCost = mpCostForDiff(qCheck.diff);
            if (!force && (hunter.mp || 0) < mpCost) {
                playErrorSound();
                showToast(`MP TIDAK CUKUP! Butuh ${mpCost} MP (sisa ${hunter.mp} MP).`);
                return;
            }

            const q = quests.splice(index, 1)[0];

            hunter.mp = Math.max(0, hunter.mp - mpCost);

            // Buka quest lain yang butuh quest ini selesai duluan (quest berantai)
            quests.forEach(dep => {
                if (dep.requiresQuestId === q.id && dep.unlocked === false) {
                    dep.unlocked = true;
                    dep.deadline = Date.now() + ((dep.durationHours || 24) * 60 * 60 * 1000);
                    showToast(`🔓 QUEST "${dep.title}" TERBUKA!`);
                    sendNotification("🔓 QUEST TERBUKA!", `"${dep.title}" sekarang bisa dikerjain!`);
                    playUnlockChainSound();
                }
            });

            let gainExp = q.exp;
            if (hunter.expMultiplier > 1) {
                gainExp *= hunter.expMultiplier;
                hunter.expMultiplier = 1;
            }
            if (hunter.expBonusPercent > 0) {
                gainExp = Math.round(gainExp * (1 + hunter.expBonusPercent / 100));
                hunter.expBonusPercent = 0;
            }

            let gainGold = (q.diff === 'HARD') ? 5 : (q.diff === 'NORMAL' ? 3 : 1);
            
            if (q.diff === 'HARD' && hunter.hardcoreSeal) {
                gainGold *= 2;
                hunter.hardcoreSeal = false;
            }

            if (hunter.goldBonusFlat > 0) {
                gainGold += hunter.goldBonusFlat;
                hunter.goldBonusFlat = 0;
            }

            hunter.exp += gainExp;
            hunter.gold += gainGold;

            const bossDmg = damageBoss(gainExp);

            hunter.totalCompleted = (hunter.totalCompleted || 0) + 1;
            hunter.totalExpGained = (hunter.totalExpGained || 0) + gainExp;
            hunter.totalGoldGained = (hunter.totalGoldGained || 0) + gainGold;
            if (q.isDaily) hunter.totalDailyCompleted = (hunter.totalDailyCompleted || 0) + 1;

            // FIX: simpan kondisi streak SEBELUM berubah, biar kalau di-UNDO
            // nanti streak-nya bisa dibalikin persis, bukan cuma dikurangin 1
            // (soalnya quest ke-2/3/dst di hari yang sama gak nambah streak).
            const prevStreak = hunter.streak;
            const prevLastStreakDate = hunter.lastStreakDate;

            const today = getTodayString();
            if (hunter.lastStreakDate !== today) {
                hunter.streak += 1;
                hunter.lastStreakDate = today;
            }

            checkLevelUp();
            checkQuestCountAchievements();
            checkStreakAchievements();
            checkGoldAchievements();
            checkDailyAchievements();

            finishedQuests.push({
                ...q,
                gainedExp: gainExp,
                gainedGold: gainGold,
                bossDamageDealt: bossDmg,
                prevStreak: prevStreak,
                prevLastStreakDate: prevLastStreakDate,
                completedAt: new Date().toISOString()
            });

            // FATIGUE: boleh nyelesaiin sampai FATIGUE_FREE_QUEST_LIMIT (3) quest
            // berturut-turut dalam ambang waktu tertentu TANPA kena capek. Baru
            // quest ke-4 dst dalam ambang waktu yang sama bikin FATIGUE (clear
            // quest dikunci 5 menit). Ambang waktunya default 60 detik, tapi
            // AGI/INT di atas 10 masing-masing nambah 10 detik ke ambang ini.
            // Kalau lagi imun Fatigue (efek Phoenix Feather), skip pengecekan ini.
            const nowTs = Date.now();
            let fatigueTriggered = false;
            const fatigueImmune = hunter.fatigueImmuneUntil && nowTs < hunter.fatigueImmuneUntil;
            if (!fatigueImmune) {
                const fatigueWindow = computeFatigueWindowMs();
                if (hunter.lastQuestCompleteTime && (nowTs - hunter.lastQuestCompleteTime) <= fatigueWindow) {
                    hunter.quickCompleteStreak = (hunter.quickCompleteStreak || 1) + 1;
                } else {
                    hunter.quickCompleteStreak = 1;
                }
                if (hunter.quickCompleteStreak > FATIGUE_FREE_QUEST_LIMIT) {
                    hunter.fatigueUntil = nowTs + FATIGUE_DURATION_MS;
                    fatigueTriggered = true;
                    hunter.quickCompleteStreak = 0;
                }
            }
            hunter.lastQuestCompleteTime = nowTs;

            saveData(); refreshUI();
            playQuestCompleteSound();
            showToast(force ? `⏳ QUEST "${q.title}" SELESAI OTOMATIS! (+${gainExp} EXP, +${gainGold} Gold)` : `QUEST SELESAI! (+${gainExp} EXP, +${gainGold} Gold, -${mpCost} MP)`);
            if (fatigueTriggered) {
                showToast("⚡ FATIGUE! Kamu kecapekan, clear quest dikunci 5 menit.");
            }
        }

        /* --- SOUND EFFECT (Web Audio API, tanpa file eksternal) --- */
        let audioCtx = null;

        function getAudioCtx() {
            if (!audioCtx) {
                const AC = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext;
                if (!AC) return null;
                audioCtx = new AC();
            }
            if (audioCtx.state === 'suspended') audioCtx.resume();
            return audioCtx;
        }

        function playTone(ctx, freq, startTime, duration, volume) {
            const osc = ctx.createOscillator();
            const gain = ctx.createGain();
            osc.type = 'sine';
            osc.frequency.value = freq;
            gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0, startTime);
            gain.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(volume, startTime + 0.02);
            gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, startTime + duration);
            osc.connect(gain);
            gain.connect(ctx.destination);
            osc.start(startTime);
            osc.stop(startTime + duration);
        }

        function playQuestCompleteSound() {
            if (hunter.soundEnabled === false) return;
            try {
                const ctx = getAudioCtx();
                if (!ctx) return;
                const now = ctx.currentTime;
                playTone(ctx, 523.25, now, 0.15, 0.15);        // C5
                playTone(ctx, 783.99, now + 0.09, 0.28, 0.18); // G5
            } catch (e) {
                // audio nggak didukung / diblokir, abaikan diam-diam
            }
        }
