        function toggleSoundSetting() {
            hunter.soundEnabled = document.getElementById('sound-toggle').checked;
            saveData();
            if (hunter.soundEnabled) playQuestCompleteSound();
        }

        function checkLevelUp() {
            while (hunter.exp >= 1000) {
                hunter.exp -= 1000;
                hunter.level += 1;
                showToast("LEVEL UP! SEKARANG LEVEL " + hunter.level);
                sendNotification("⬆ LEVEL UP!", `${hunter.name} sekarang Level ${hunter.level}!`);
                playLevelUpSound();

                if (hunter.level % 3 === 0) {
                    hunter.statPoints = (hunter.statPoints || 0) + 1;
                    showToast("🌟 DAPAT 1 STAT POINT!");
                }

                if (hunter.level % 20 === 0 && hunter.rankIndex < ranks.length - 1) {
                    hunter.rankIndex += 1;
                    showToast("RANK UP! SEKARANG " + ranks[hunter.rankIndex]);
                    sendNotification("🏆 RANK UP!", `${hunter.name} naik ke ${ranks[hunter.rankIndex]}!`);
                    playRankUpSound();
                    checkRankAchievements();
                }
            }
        }

        function renderFinishedQuests() {
            const container = document.getElementById('finished-list');
            container.innerHTML = '';

            if (finishedQuests.length === 0) {
                container.innerHTML = `<div style="font-size:0.75rem; color:var(--text-muted);">Tidak ada quest dalam verifikasi.</div>`;
                return;
            }

            finishedQuests.forEach((q, idx) => {
                const item = document.createElement('div');
                item.className = 'list-card';

                if (q.pendingDelete) {
                    item.style.borderColor = 'var(--danger-glow)';
                    item.innerHTML = `
                        <div style="font-size:0.85rem; font-weight:bold; color:#fff;">🗑️ ${q.title} ${q.isDaily ? '<span class="daily-badge">DAILY QUEST</span>' : ''}</div>
                        <div style="font-size:0.7rem; color:var(--danger-glow);">Menunggu konfirmasi hapus...</div>
                        <div style="display:flex; gap:8px; margin-top:6px;">
                            <button class="btn-neon" style="flex:1;" onclick="cancelPendingDelete(${idx})">BATALKAN</button>
                            <button class="btn-neon btn-neon-danger" style="flex:2;" onclick="confirmPendingDelete(${idx})">HAPUS PERMANEN</button>
                        </div>
                    `;
                } else {
                    item.innerHTML = `
                        <div style="font-size:0.85rem; font-weight:bold; color:#fff;">${q.title} ${q.isDaily ? '<span class="daily-badge">DAILY QUEST</span>' : ''}</div>
                        <div style="font-size:0.7rem; color:var(--text-muted);">+${q.gainedExp} EXP | +${q.gainedGold} Gold | ${formatDateLabel(q.completedAt)}</div>
                        <div style="display:flex; gap:8px; margin-top:6px;">
                            <button class="btn-neon btn-neon-danger" style="flex:1;" onclick="undoQuest(${idx})">UNDO</button>
                            <button class="btn-neon btn-neon-yellow" style="flex:2;" onclick="confirmComplete(${idx})">COMPLETELY FINISHED?</button>
                        </div>
                    `;
                }
                container.appendChild(item);
            });
        }

        function undoQuest(index) {
            const q = finishedQuests.splice(index, 1)[0];
            hunter.exp = Math.max(0, hunter.exp - q.gainedExp);
            hunter.gold = Math.max(0, hunter.gold - q.gainedGold);

            // FIX: damage yang sudah diberikan ke boss mingguan juga tidak pernah
            // dikembalikan saat UNDO. Sekarang HP boss dikembalikan (kalau boss
            // itu belum diganti oleh boss minggu baru).
            if (bossState && typeof q.bossDamageDealt === 'number' && q.bossDamageDealt > 0) {
                bossState.currentHp = Math.min(bossState.maxHp, bossState.currentHp + q.bossDamageDealt);
                saveBossData();
            }

            hunter.totalCompleted = Math.max(0, hunter.totalCompleted - 1);
            hunter.totalExpGained = Math.max(0, hunter.totalExpGained - q.gainedExp);
            hunter.totalGoldGained = Math.max(0, hunter.totalGoldGained - q.gainedGold);
            if (q.isDaily) hunter.totalDailyCompleted = Math.max(0, (hunter.totalDailyCompleted || 0) - 1);

            // FIX: streak yang berubah gara-gara quest ini diselesaikan sekarang
            // ikut dibalikin persis ke kondisi sebelumnya.
            if (typeof q.prevStreak === 'number') hunter.streak = q.prevStreak;
            if (typeof q.prevLastStreakDate === 'string') hunter.lastStreakDate = q.prevLastStreakDate;

            // FIX: sebelumnya cuma sebagian field quest yang dikembalikan pas
            // UNDO (title/exp/diff/deadline/isDaily doang), jadi kalau quest-nya
            // tipe bertahap (progressive) atau punya prasyarat, data itu ilang
            // dan quest balik jadi quest biasa. Sekarang semua field aslinya
            // dikembalikan utuh, cuma metadata hasil selesai yang dibuang.
            const {
                gainedExp, gainedGold, bossDamageDealt,
                prevStreak: _prevStreak, prevLastStreakDate: _prevLastStreakDate,
                completedAt, notifiedSoon, ...restoredQuest
            } = q;
            quests.push(restoredQuest);

            saveData(); refreshUI();
            showToast("QUEST DI-UNDO (Reward & Stat Ditarik Kembali)");
        }

        function confirmComplete(index) {
            const q = finishedQuests.splice(index, 1)[0];
            historyQuests.unshift(q);
            saveData(); refreshUI();
            showToast("QUEST DIPINDAHKAN KE HISTORY!");
        }

        function renderHistoryQuests() {
            const container = document.getElementById('history-list');
            container.innerHTML = '';

            if (historyQuests.length === 0) {
                container.innerHTML = `<div style="font-size:0.75rem; color:var(--text-muted);">History masih kosong.</div>`;
                return;
            }

            historyQuests.forEach((q, idx) => {
                const item = document.createElement('div');
                item.className = 'list-card';
                if (q.failed) item.style.borderColor = 'var(--danger-glow)';
                item.innerHTML = `
                    <div style="display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:flex-start;">
                        <div>
                            <div style="font-size:0.85rem; font-weight:bold; color:#fff;">${q.title} ${q.isDaily ? '<span class="daily-badge">DAILY QUEST</span>' : ''} ${q.failed ? '<span class="daily-badge" style="border-color:var(--danger-glow); color:var(--danger-glow);">✕ GAGAL</span>' : ''}</div>
                            <div style="font-size:0.68rem; color:${q.failed ? 'var(--danger-glow)' : 'var(--cyan-glow)'}; margin-top:3px;">${q.failed ? `📅 Gagal pada: ${formatDateLabel(q.completedAt)} (-2 Gold)` : `📅 Selesai pada: ${formatDateLabel(q.completedAt)}`}</div>
                        </div>
                        <button class="btn-neon btn-neon-danger" style="padding:2px 8px; font-size:0.6rem;" onclick="deleteHistoryQuest(${idx})">HAPUS</button>
                    </div>
                `;
                container.appendChild(item);
            });
        }

        function deleteHistoryQuest(index) {
            historyQuests.splice(index, 1);
            saveData(); refreshUI();
            playDeleteSound();
            showToast("QUEST DIHAPUS DARI HISTORY!");
        }

        /* --- SHOP MANAGEMENT --- */
        function renderShop() {
            const container = document.getElementById('shop-items-container');
            container.innerHTML = '';

            shopCatalog.forEach(item => {
                const card = document.createElement('div');
                card.className = 'list-card';
                card.innerHTML = `
                    <div style="display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center;">
                        <div>
                            <div style="font-size:0.85rem; font-weight:bold; color:var(--purple-glow);">${item.name}</div>
                            <div style="font-size:0.7rem; color:var(--text-muted);">${item.desc}</div>
                        </div>
                        <button class="btn-neon btn-neon-yellow" onclick="buyShopItem('${item.id}', ${item.cost})">${item.cost} GOLD</button>
                    </div>
                `;
                container.appendChild(card);
            });
        }

        function buyShopItem(itemId, cost) {
            if (hunter.gold < cost) { playErrorSound(); return showToast("GOLD TIDAK CUKUP!"); }

            const shopDef = shopCatalog.find(i => i.id === itemId);
            // Item consumable & equipment gak langsung dipakai, tapi masuk ke
            // Inventory dulu. Dari situ baru bisa "digunakan" (konsumabel) atau
            // "dipasang" (equipment) lewat tab INVENTORY / EQUIPMENT.
            if (shopDef && (shopDef.type === 'consumable' || shopDef.type === 'equipment')) {
                hunter.gold -= cost;
                if (!hunter.inventory) hunter.inventory = {};
                hunter.inventory[itemId] = (hunter.inventory[itemId] || 0) + 1;
                playCoinSound();
                showToast(`${shopDef.name} MASUK KE INVENTORY!`);
                saveData(); refreshUI();
                return;
            }

            if (itemId === 'wisdom') {
                hunter.gold -= cost;
                hunter.str += 5; hunter.agi += 5; hunter.vit += 5; hunter.int = (hunter.int || 10) + 5;
                showToast("+5 ALL STATS DITERIMA!");
            } else if (itemId === 'ranktoken') {
                if (hunter.rankIndex >= ranks.length - 1) { playErrorSound(); return showToast("SUDAH RANK MAKSIMAL (RANK S)!"); }
                hunter.gold -= cost;
                hunter.rankIndex += 1;
                showToast("RANK NAIK KE " + ranks[hunter.rankIndex]);
                playRankUpSound();
                checkRankAchievements();
            } else if (itemId === 'recovery') {
                hunter.gold -= cost;
                hunter.streak += 1;
                hunter.lastStreakDate = getTodayString();
                showToast("STREAK DIBERSIHKAN & DITAMBAH +1!");
            } else if (itemId === 'extra1') {
                hunter.gold -= cost;
                hunter.limit += 1;
                showToast("LIMIT QUEST +1 PERMANEN!");
            } else if (itemId === 'backpack') {
                hunter.gold -= cost;
                hunter.limit += 3;
                showToast("LIMIT QUEST +3 PERMANEN!");
            } else if (itemId === 'mystery') {
                hunter.gold -= cost;
                openMysteryBox();
            }

            if (itemId !== 'ranktoken') playCoinSound();
            saveData(); refreshUI();
        }

        function openMysteryBox() {
            const prizes = [
                { name: "+10 Gold", action: () => hunter.gold += 10 },
                { name: "+50 Gold", action: () => hunter.gold += 50 },
                { name: "+300 EXP", action: () => { hunter.exp += 300; checkLevelUp(); } },
                { name: "+2 All Stats", action: () => { hunter.str += 2; hunter.agi += 2; hunter.vit += 2; hunter.int = (hunter.int || 10) + 2; } },
                { name: "Zonk! Dapat 1 Gold", action: () => hunter.gold += 1 }
            ];
            const rand = prizes[Math.floor(Math.random() * prizes.length)];
            rand.action();
            showToast("MYSTERY BOX: " + rand.name);
        }

        /* --- INVENTORY --- */
        // Nerapin efek 1 item konsumabel dari Inventory. Balikin false kalau
        // gagal dipakai (misal timeext tapi gak ada quest aktif) supaya qty-nya
        // gak ikut kepotong walau gagal.
        function applyConsumableEffect(itemId) {
            if (itemId === 'hardcore') {
                hunter.hardcoreSeal = true;
                showToast("HARDCORE SEAL DIAKTIFKAN!");
            } else if (itemId === 'exp2') {
                hunter.expMultiplier = 2;
                showToast("2X EXP DIAKTIFKAN!");
            } else if (itemId === 'exp3') {
                hunter.expMultiplier = 3;
                showToast("3X EXP DIAKTIFKAN!");
            } else if (itemId === 'goldbooster') {
                hunter.goldBonusFlat = 5;
                showToast("GOLD BOOSTER (+5 G) DIAKTIFKAN!");
            } else if (itemId === 'timeext') {
                if (quests.length === 0) { playErrorSound(); return false; }
                quests.forEach(q => {
                    if (q.unlocked !== false) {
                        q.deadline += 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000;
                        q.notifiedSoon = false;
                    }
                });
                showToast("ALL QUEST DEADLINE +24 JAM!");
            } else if (itemId === 'charm') {
                hunter.expBonusPercent = 50;
                showToast("LUCKY CHARM (+50% EXP) DIAKTIFKAN!");
            } else if (itemId === 'energydrink') {
                if (!isFatigued()) { playErrorSound(); return false; }
                hunter.fatigueUntil = 0;
                hunter.quickCompleteStreak = 0;
                showToast("⚡ FATIGUE HILANG! Bisa clear quest lagi sekarang.");
            } else if (itemId === 'hppotion_s') {
                syncVitalCaps();
                if (hunter.hp >= hunter.maxHp) { playErrorSound(); return false; }
                hunter.hp = Math.min(hunter.maxHp, hunter.hp + 40);
                showToast(`🧪 +40 HP! (${hunter.hp}/${hunter.maxHp})`);
            } else if (itemId === 'hppotion_l') {
                syncVitalCaps();
                if (hunter.hp >= hunter.maxHp) { playErrorSound(); return false; }
                hunter.hp = Math.min(hunter.maxHp, hunter.hp + 100);
                showToast(`🧪 +100 HP! (${hunter.hp}/${hunter.maxHp})`);
            } else if (itemId === 'mppotion_s') {
                syncVitalCaps();
                if (hunter.mp >= hunter.maxMp) { playErrorSound(); return false; }
                hunter.mp = Math.min(hunter.maxMp, hunter.mp + 60);
                showToast(`💧 +60 MP! (${hunter.mp}/${hunter.maxMp})`);
            } else if (itemId === 'mppotion_l') {
                syncVitalCaps();
                if (hunter.mp >= hunter.maxMp) { playErrorSound(); return false; }
                hunter.mp = Math.min(hunter.maxMp, hunter.mp + 150);
                showToast(`💧 +150 MP! (${hunter.mp}/${hunter.maxMp})`);
            } else if (itemId === 'fullrestore') {
                syncVitalCaps();
                if (hunter.hp >= hunter.maxHp && hunter.mp >= hunter.maxMp) { playErrorSound(); return false; }
                hunter.hp = hunter.maxHp;
                hunter.mp = hunter.maxMp;
                showToast("✨ HP & MP DIPULIHKAN PENUH!");
            } else if (itemId === 'phoenixdown') {
                syncVitalCaps();
                hunter.hp = hunter.maxHp;
                hunter.fatigueUntil = 0;
                hunter.quickCompleteStreak = 0;
                hunter.fatigueImmuneUntil = Date.now() + 10 * 60 * 1000;
                showToast("🪶 HP PENUH! Imun Fatigue 10 menit!");
            }
            return true;
        }

        function useInventoryItem(itemId) {
            if (!hunter.inventory) hunter.inventory = {};
            const qty = hunter.inventory[itemId] || 0;
            if (qty <= 0) { playErrorSound(); return showToast("ITEM TIDAK ADA DI INVENTORY!"); }

            syncVitalCaps();

            if (itemId === 'timeext' && quests.length === 0) {
                playErrorSound();
                return showToast("TIDAK ADA QUEST AKTIF!");
            }
            if (itemId === 'energydrink' && !isFatigued()) {
                playErrorSound();
                return showToast("KAMU TIDAK SEDANG FATIGUE!");
            }
            if ((itemId === 'hppotion_s' || itemId === 'hppotion_l') && hunter.hp >= hunter.maxHp) {
                playErrorSound();
                return showToast("HP SUDAH PENUH!");
            }
            if ((itemId === 'mppotion_s' || itemId === 'mppotion_l') && hunter.mp >= hunter.maxMp) {
                playErrorSound();
                return showToast("MP SUDAH PENUH!");
            }
            if (itemId === 'fullrestore' && hunter.hp >= hunter.maxHp && hunter.mp >= hunter.maxMp) {
                playErrorSound();
                return showToast("HP & MP SUDAH PENUH!");
            }

            const ok = applyConsumableEffect(itemId);
            if (ok === false) return;

            hunter.inventory[itemId] = qty - 1;
            playUseItemSound();
            saveData(); refreshUI();
        }

        function equipItem(itemId) {
            const def = shopCatalog.find(i => i.id === itemId && i.type === 'equipment');
            if (!def) return;
            if (!hunter.inventory) hunter.inventory = {};
            if (!hunter.equipped) hunter.equipped = {};

            const qty = hunter.inventory[itemId] || 0;
            if (qty <= 0) { playErrorSound(); return showToast("ITEM TIDAK ADA DI INVENTORY!"); }

            const slot = def.slot;
            const currentId = hunter.equipped[slot];
            if (currentId) {
                const curDef = shopCatalog.find(i => i.id === currentId);
                if (curDef && curDef.bonus) {
                    for (const k in curDef.bonus) hunter[k] = (hunter[k] || 10) - curDef.bonus[k];
                }
                hunter.inventory[currentId] = (hunter.inventory[currentId] || 0) + 1;
            }

            hunter.inventory[itemId] = qty - 1;
            hunter.equipped[slot] = itemId;
            for (const k in def.bonus) hunter[k] = (hunter[k] || 10) + def.bonus[k];

            syncVitalCaps();
            playEquipSound();
            showToast(`${def.name} DIPASANG! (${def.desc})`);
            saveData(); refreshUI();
        }

        function unequipItem(slot) {
            if (!hunter.equipped) return;
            const itemId = hunter.equipped[slot];
            if (!itemId) return;

            const def = shopCatalog.find(i => i.id === itemId);
            if (def && def.bonus) {
                for (const k in def.bonus) hunter[k] = (hunter[k] || 10) - def.bonus[k];
            }
            if (!hunter.inventory) hunter.inventory = {};
            hunter.inventory[itemId] = (hunter.inventory[itemId] || 0) + 1;
            hunter.equipped[slot] = null;

            syncVitalCaps();
            playEquipSound();
            showToast(`${def ? def.name : 'Item'} DILEPAS!`);
            saveData(); refreshUI();
        }

        function renderInventory() {
            const container = document.getElementById('inventory-list');
            if (!container) return;
            container.innerHTML = '';
            if (!hunter.inventory) hunter.inventory = {};

            const owned = shopCatalog.filter(item => (hunter.inventory[item.id] || 0) > 0);

            if (owned.length === 0) {
                container.innerHTML = '<div style="font-size:0.75rem; color:var(--text-muted); text-align:center; padding:20px 0;">Inventory kosong. Beli item di tab SHOP!</div>';
                return;
            }

            owned.forEach(item => {
                const qty = hunter.inventory[item.id];
                const card = document.createElement('div');
                card.className = 'list-card';
                const actionBtn = item.type === 'equipment'
                    ? `<button class="btn-neon" onclick="equipItem('${item.id}')">PASANG</button>`
                    : `<button class="btn-neon btn-neon-yellow" onclick="useInventoryItem('${item.id}')">GUNAKAN</button>`;
                card.innerHTML = `
                    <div style="display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; gap:8px;">
                        <div>
                            <div style="font-size:0.85rem; font-weight:bold; color:var(--purple-glow);">${item.name} <span style="color:var(--text-muted); font-weight:400;">x${qty}</span></div>
                            <div style="font-size:0.7rem; color:var(--text-muted);">${item.desc}</div>
                        </div>
                        ${actionBtn}
                    </div>
                `;
                container.appendChild(card);
            });
        }

        /* --- EQUIPMENT --- */
        function renderEquipSlotBox(slotKey) {
            const meta = equipSlotMeta[slotKey];
            const equippedId = (hunter.equipped || {})[slotKey];
            const def = equippedId ? shopCatalog.find(i => i.id === equippedId) : null;

            const box = document.createElement('div');
            box.className = 'equip-slot-box' + (def ? ' filled' : '');
            box.innerHTML = def
                ? `<div class="equip-slot-icon">${def.icon}</div>
                   <div class="equip-slot-name">${def.name.replace(/^\S+\s/, '')}</div>
                   <div class="equip-slot-bonus">${def.desc}</div>
                   <button class="btn-neon btn-neon-danger" style="padding:2px 6px; font-size:0.58rem; margin-top:2px;" onclick="unequipItem('${slotKey}')">LEPAS</button>`
                : `<div class="equip-slot-icon" style="opacity:0.3;">${meta.icon}</div>
                   <div class="equip-slot-name" style="color:var(--text-muted);">${meta.label}</div>
                   <div class="equip-slot-empty">Kosong</div>`;
            return box;
        }

        function renderEquipment() {
            const left = document.getElementById('equip-col-left');
            const right = document.getElementById('equip-col-right');
            if (!left || !right) return;

            left.innerHTML = '';
            right.innerHTML = '';
            equipSlotsLeft.forEach(slotKey => left.appendChild(renderEquipSlotBox(slotKey)));
            equipSlotsRight.forEach(slotKey => right.appendChild(renderEquipSlotBox(slotKey)));
        }

        /* --- ACHIEVEMENTS --- */
        function unlockAchievement(id) {
            const a = achievements.find(x => x.id === id);
            if (a && !a.unlocked) {
                a.unlocked = true;
                showToast("ACHIEVEMENT UNLOCKED: " + a.name);
                sendNotification("🏆 ACHIEVEMENT UNLOCKED", a.name);
                playAchievementSound();
                saveData();
            }
        }

        function checkQuestCountAchievements() {
            const total = hunter.totalCompleted || 0;
            if (total >= 1) unlockAchievement(1);
            if (total >= 10) unlockAchievement(2);
            if (total >= 100) unlockAchievement(3);
            if (total >= 1000) unlockAchievement(4);
        }

        function checkStreakAchievements() {
            if (hunter.streak >= 7) unlockAchievement(5);
            if (hunter.streak >= 30) unlockAchievement(6);
        }

        function checkGoldAchievements() {
            const totalGold = hunter.totalGoldGained || 0;
            if (totalGold >= 500) unlockAchievement(7);
            if (totalGold >= 2000) unlockAchievement(8);
        }

        function checkRankAchievements() {
            if (hunter.rankIndex >= ranks.indexOf("RANK C")) unlockAchievement(9);
            if (hunter.rankIndex >= ranks.indexOf("RANK S")) unlockAchievement(10);
        }

        function checkDailyAchievements() {
            if ((hunter.totalDailyCompleted || 0) >= 50) unlockAchievement(11);
        }

        function checkBossAchievements() {
            if ((hunter.totalBossesDefeated || 0) >= 5) unlockAchievement(12);
        }

        function renderAchievements() {
            const container = document.getElementById('achieve-list');
            container.innerHTML = '';

            achievements.forEach(a => {
                const item = document.createElement('div');
                item.className = 'list-card';
                item.style.borderColor = a.unlocked ? 'var(--yellow-glow)' : 'var(--border-color)';
                item.innerHTML = `
                    <div style="font-size:0.85rem; font-weight:bold; color:${a.unlocked ? 'var(--yellow-glow)' : 'var(--text-muted)'}">${a.name} ${a.unlocked ? '🏆' : '🔒'}</div>
                    <div style="font-size:0.7rem; color:var(--text-muted);">${a.desc}</div>
                `;
                container.appendChild(item);
            });
        }

        /* --- TITLE --- */
        function renderTitleOptions() {
            const sel = document.getElementById('title-select');
            if (!sel) return;

            const unlockedTitles = titleCatalog.filter(t =>
                t.achievementId === null || achievements.some(a => a.id === t.achievementId && a.unlocked)
            );

            // Kalau title yang lagi dipakai ternyata belum/gak lagi terbuka
            // (misal data lama), jatuhin balik ke title default.
            if (!unlockedTitles.some(t => t.name === hunter.title)) {
                hunter.title = "Novice";
            }

            sel.innerHTML = unlockedTitles.map(t =>
                `<option value="${t.name}" ${hunter.title === t.name ? 'selected' : ''}>${t.name}</option>`
            ).join('');
        }

        function updateTitle() {
            const sel = document.getElementById('title-select');
            if (!sel) return;
            hunter.title = sel.value;
            saveData(); refreshUI();
            showToast("TITLE DIGANTI: " + hunter.title);
        }

        /* --- GOALS --- */
        function addGoal() {
            const title = document.getElementById('goal-title').value.trim();
            const date = document.getElementById('goal-date').value;

            if (!title) return showToast("Masukkan nama goal!");

            goals.push({
                id: Date.now(),
                title: title,
                targetDate: date || null,
                done: false,
                createdAt: new Date().toISOString()
            });

            document.getElementById('goal-title').value = '';
            document.getElementById('goal-date').value = '';
            saveData(); refreshUI();
            showToast("GOAL BARU DITAMBAHKAN!");
        }

        function toggleGoalDone(id) {
            const g = goals.find(x => x.id === id);
            if (!g) return;
            g.done = !g.done;
            saveData(); refreshUI();
            if (g.done) showToast(`GOAL "${g.title}" TERCAPAI! 🎉`);
        }

        function deleteGoal(id) {
            goals = goals.filter(x => x.id !== id);
            saveData(); refreshUI();
            playDeleteSound();
            showToast("GOAL DIHAPUS!");
        }

        function formatSimpleDate(dateStr) {
            if (!dateStr) return '';
            const d = new Date(dateStr + 'T00:00:00');
            const day = String(d.getDate()).padStart(2, '0');
            const month = String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0');
            return `${day}/${month}/${d.getFullYear()}`;
        }

        function renderGoals() {
            const container = document.getElementById('goals-list');
            container.innerHTML = '';

            // Goal yang udah lewat deadline (pendingVerification) ditampilkan
            // terpisah di tab FINISHED, jadi gak dobel muncul di sini.
            const activeGoals = goals.filter(g => !g.pendingVerification);

            if (activeGoals.length === 0) {
                container.innerHTML = `<div style="font-size:0.75rem; color:var(--text-muted);">Belum ada goal.</div>`;
                return;
            }

            activeGoals.forEach(g => {
                const card = document.createElement('div');
                card.className = 'goal-card' + (g.done ? ' done' : '');
                card.innerHTML = `
                    <div class="goal-title-row">
                        <input type="checkbox" class="goal-checkbox" ${g.done ? 'checked' : ''} onchange="toggleGoalDone(${g.id})">
                        <div class="goal-title${g.done ? ' done' : ''}">${g.title}</div>
                        <button class="btn-neon btn-neon-danger" style="padding:2px 8px; font-size:0.6rem;" onclick="deleteGoal(${g.id})">HAPUS</button>
                    </div>
                    ${g.targetDate ? `<div class="goal-meta">🎯 Target: ${formatSimpleDate(g.targetDate)}</div>` : ''}
                `;
                container.appendChild(card);
            });
        }

        // Cek goal yang deadline-nya udah lewat (dan belum selesai/belum
        // nunggu verifikasi) -> otomatis dipindah ke tab FINISHED buat
        // diverifikasi (selesai atau perpanjang deadline dulu).
        function checkGoalsDeadline() {
            const todayStr = getTodayString();
            let changed = false;

            goals.forEach(g => {
                if (!g.done && !g.pendingVerification && g.targetDate && g.targetDate < todayStr) {
                    g.pendingVerification = true;
                    changed = true;
                    sendNotification("🎯 GOAL LEWAT DEADLINE", `"${g.title}" perlu diverifikasi atau diperpanjang di tab FINISHED.`);
                }
            });

            if (changed) {
                saveData();
                showToast("ADA GOAL YANG LEWAT DEADLINE, VERIFIKASI DI TAB FINISHED!");
                refreshUI();
            }
        }

        function renderPendingGoals() {
            const container = document.getElementById('goals-pending-list');
            if (!container) return;
            container.innerHTML = '';

            const pending = goals.filter(g => g.pendingVerification);

            if (pending.length === 0) {
                container.innerHTML = `<div style="font-size:0.75rem; color:var(--text-muted);">Tidak ada goal yang menunggu verifikasi.</div>`;
                return;
            }

            pending.forEach(g => {
                const item = document.createElement('div');
                item.className = 'list-card';
                item.style.borderColor = 'var(--yellow-glow)';
                item.innerHTML = `
                    <div style="font-size:0.85rem; font-weight:bold; color:#fff;">🎯 ${g.title}</div>
                    <div style="font-size:0.7rem; color:var(--yellow-glow);">Deadline lewat: ${formatSimpleDate(g.targetDate)}</div>
                    <div style="display:flex; gap:6px; margin-top:8px; align-items:center; flex-wrap:wrap;">
                        <input type="date" id="extend-date-${g.id}" class="form-control" style="flex:1; min-width:120px;">
                        <button class="btn-neon" style="flex:1;" onclick="extendGoalDeadline(${g.id})">PERPANJANG</button>
                    </div>
                    <div style="display:flex; gap:8px; margin-top:6px;">
                        <button class="btn-neon btn-neon-yellow" style="flex:1;" onclick="verifyGoalDone(${g.id})">TANDAI SELESAI</button>
                        <button class="btn-neon btn-neon-danger" style="flex:1;" onclick="deleteGoal(${g.id})">HAPUS</button>
                    </div>
                `;
                container.appendChild(item);
            });
        }

        function extendGoalDeadline(id) {
            const g = goals.find(x => x.id === id);
            if (!g) return;

            const input = document.getElementById(`extend-date-${id}`);
            const newDate = input ? input.value : '';
            if (!newDate) {
                playErrorSound();
                showToast("Pilih tanggal deadline baru dulu!");
                return;
            }

            g.targetDate = newDate;
            g.pendingVerification = false;
            saveData(); refreshUI();
            showToast(`DEADLINE GOAL "${g.title}" DIPERPANJANG KE ${formatSimpleDate(newDate)}!`);
        }

        function verifyGoalDone(id) {
            const g = goals.find(x => x.id === id);
            if (!g) return;

            g.done = true;
            g.pendingVerification = false;
            saveData(); refreshUI();
            showToast(`GOAL "${g.title}" TERVERIFIKASI SELESAI! 🎉`);
        }

        /* --- NOTEPAD --- */
        function onNotepadType() {
            const statusEl = document.getElementById('notepad-status');
            if (statusEl) statusEl.innerText = "Mengetik...";
            clearTimeout(notepadSaveTimer);
            notepadSaveTimer = setTimeout(() => saveNotepad(false), 1500);
        }

        function saveNotepad(showFeedback) {
            notepadText = document.getElementById('notepad-area').value;
            localStorage.setItem('rpg_notepad', notepadText);
            const statusEl = document.getElementById('notepad-status');
            if (statusEl) statusEl.innerText = "Tersimpan " + new Date().toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' });
            if (showFeedback) showToast("CATATAN TERSIMPAN!");
        }

        /* --- STOPWATCH SEDERHANA (tab NOTES) --- */
        let stopwatchInterval = null;
        let stopwatchElapsedMs = 0;
        let stopwatchRunning = false;
        let stopwatchStartTs = 0;

        function formatStopwatch(ms) {
            const totalSec = Math.floor(ms / 1000);
            const h = Math.floor(totalSec / 3600);
            const m = Math.floor((totalSec % 3600) / 60);
            const s = totalSec % 60;
            const pad = n => String(n).padStart(2, '0');
            return `${pad(h)}:${pad(m)}:${pad(s)}`;
        }

        function stopwatchTick() {
            const display = document.getElementById('stopwatch-display');
            if (!display) return;
            display.innerText = formatStopwatch(stopwatchElapsedMs + (Date.now() - stopwatchStartTs));
        }

        function stopwatchToggle() {
            const btn = document.getElementById('stopwatch-btn');
            if (!stopwatchRunning) {
                stopwatchRunning = true;
                stopwatchStartTs = Date.now();
                stopwatchInterval = setInterval(stopwatchTick, 1000);
                if (btn) btn.innerText = 'JEDA';
            } else {
                stopwatchRunning = false;
                stopwatchElapsedMs += Date.now() - stopwatchStartTs;
                clearInterval(stopwatchInterval);
                if (btn) btn.innerText = 'MULAI';
            }
        }

        function stopwatchReset() {
            stopwatchRunning = false;
            clearInterval(stopwatchInterval);
            stopwatchElapsedMs = 0;
            const display = document.getElementById('stopwatch-display');
            if (display) display.innerText = '00:00:00';
            const btn = document.getElementById('stopwatch-btn');
            if (btn) btn.innerText = 'MULAI';
        }

                document.getElementById('admin-level-input').value = hunter.level;
                showToast("VERIFIKASI BERHASIL!");

                showToast("PIN SALAH!");
            }
        }

        }

        /* --- TAB & SIDE MENU NAVIGATION --- */
        function switchTab(evt, tabId) {
            playTabSwitchSound();
            document.querySelectorAll('.tab-btn').forEach(btn => btn.classList.remove('active'));
            document.querySelectorAll('.tab-content').forEach(content => content.classList.remove('active'));
            evt.currentTarget.classList.add('active');
            document.getElementById(tabId).classList.add('active');
        }

        function switchSubTab(evt, subId) {
            playTabSwitchSound();
            const nav = evt.currentTarget.closest('.sub-tabs-nav');
            const parent = nav.parentElement;
            nav.querySelectorAll('.sub-tab-btn').forEach(btn => btn.classList.remove('active'));
            parent.querySelectorAll('.sub-tab-content').forEach(content => content.classList.remove('active'));
            evt.currentTarget.classList.add('active');
            document.getElementById(subId).classList.add('active');
        }

        function toggleSideMenu(show) {
            const menu = document.getElementById('side-controller');
            if (show) menu.classList.add('active');
            else menu.classList.remove('active');
        }

        /* --- HOLIDAY SETTING --- */
        function updateHoliday() {
            hunter.holiday = document.getElementById('holiday-select').value;
            saveData();
            showToast(hunter.holiday === "None" ? "HARI LIBUR DIHAPUS!" : `HARI LIBUR DI-SET: ${hunter.holiday}`);
        }

        /* --- THEME --- */
        function applyTheme() {
            document.body.classList.remove('theme-white', 'theme-black');
            if (hunter.theme === 'white') document.body.classList.add('theme-white');
            else if (hunter.theme === 'black') document.body.classList.add('theme-black');

            const themeSelectEl = document.getElementById('theme-select');
            if (themeSelectEl) themeSelectEl.value = hunter.theme || 'neon';
        }

        function updateTheme() {
            hunter.theme = document.getElementById('theme-select').value;
            saveData();
            applyTheme();
            showToast("TEMA DIUBAH!");
        }

        /* --- AUTO-HAPUS HISTORY --- */
        function updateHistoryRetention() {
            hunter.historyRetentionHours = parseInt(document.getElementById('history-retention-select').value) || 0;
            saveData();
            purgeOldHistory();
            showToast(hunter.historyRetentionHours === 0 ? "AUTO-HAPUS HISTORY DIMATIKAN!" : `HISTORY AUTO-HAPUS SETELAH ${hunter.historyRetentionHours} JAM!`);
        }

        // Buang entri HISTORY yang completedAt-nya udah lebih lama dari batas
        // retensi yang di-set user (0 = gak pernah auto-hapus).
        function purgeOldHistory() {
            if (!hunter.historyRetentionHours) return;
            const cutoff = Date.now() - (hunter.historyRetentionHours * 60 * 60 * 1000);
            const before = historyQuests.length;
            historyQuests = historyQuests.filter(q => {
                const t = Date.parse(q.completedAt);
                return isNaN(t) ? true : t >= cutoff;
            });
            if (historyQuests.length !== before) {
                saveData(); refreshUI();
            }
        }

        /* --- RESET --- */
        /* --- MODAL KONFIRMASI GENERIK --- */
        let pendingConfirmAction = null;

        function showConfirmModal(message, action) {
            document.getElementById('confirm-modal-text').innerText = message;
            pendingConfirmAction = action;
            document.getElementById('confirm-modal').classList.add('active');
        }

        function closeConfirmModal() {
            document.getElementById('confirm-modal').classList.remove('active');
            pendingConfirmAction = null;
        }

        function confirmModalYes() {
            if (typeof pendingConfirmAction === 'function') pendingConfirmAction();
            closeConfirmModal();
        }

        /* --- MODAL EDIT NAMA QUEST (dipicu tarik quest ke bawah) --- */
        let editingQuestIndex = null;

        function openEditQuestModal(index) {
            const q = quests[index];
            if (!q) return;
            editingQuestIndex = index;
            document.getElementById('edit-quest-title').value = q.title;
            document.getElementById('edit-quest-label').value = q.label || '';
            document.getElementById('edit-quest-progressive').checked = !!q.isProgressive;
            document.getElementById('edit-quest-target').value = q.target || 100;
            document.getElementById('edit-quest-target-group').style.display = q.isProgressive ? 'flex' : 'none';
            document.getElementById('edit-quest-auto-complete').checked = !!q.autoComplete;
            document.getElementById('edit-quest-modal').classList.add('active');
        }

        function toggleEditProgressiveInput() {
            const checked = document.getElementById('edit-quest-progressive').checked;
            document.getElementById('edit-quest-target-group').style.display = checked ? 'flex' : 'none';
        }

        function closeEditQuestModal() {
            document.getElementById('edit-quest-modal').classList.remove('active');
            editingQuestIndex = null;
        }

        function saveEditQuestName() {
            if (editingQuestIndex === null) return;
            const q = quests[editingQuestIndex];
            if (!q) { closeEditQuestModal(); return; }

            const newTitle = document.getElementById('edit-quest-title').value.trim();
            if (!newTitle) {
                playErrorSound();
                showToast("Nama quest tidak boleh kosong!");
                return;
            }

            const newLabel = document.getElementById('edit-quest-label').value.trim();
            const newProgressive = document.getElementById('edit-quest-progressive').checked;
            const newTarget = parseInt(document.getElementById('edit-quest-target').value) || 100;
            const newAutoComplete = document.getElementById('edit-quest-auto-complete').checked;

            if (newProgressive && newTarget < 1) {
                playErrorSound();
                return showToast("Target harus minimal 1!");
            }

            function applyEditQuest() {
                const oldTitle = q.title;
                q.title = newTitle;
                q.label = newLabel;

                // Kalau baru DINYALAIN jadi bertahap (sebelumnya bukan), mulai progress dari 0.
                // Kalau target berubah tapi tetep bertahap, progress lama dipertahankan (di-cap ke target baru).
                if (newProgressive && !q.isProgressive) {
                    q.current = 0;
                } else if (newProgressive && q.isProgressive) {
                    q.current = Math.min(q.current || 0, newTarget);
                } else if (!newProgressive) {
                    q.current = undefined;
                }
                q.isProgressive = newProgressive;
                q.target = newProgressive ? newTarget : undefined;
                q.autoComplete = newAutoComplete;

                // Sinkronin label prasyarat di quest lain yang nunjuk ke quest ini,
                // biar nama lama gak nyangkut di label "Butuh ... selesai dulu"
                quests.forEach(dep => {
                    if (dep.requiresQuestId === q.id) dep.requiresQuestTitle = newTitle;
                });

                saveData(); refreshUI();
                playEditSound();
                showToast(`QUEST DIUBAH: "${oldTitle}" → "${newTitle}"`);
                closeEditQuestModal();
            }

            // Konfirmasi cuma diminta kalau AUTO-SELESAI baru dinyalain (sebelumnya mati).
            // Kalau cuma matiin, atau memang udah nyala dari awal, langsung simpan aja.
            if (newAutoComplete && !q.autoComplete) {
                showConfirmModal(`Apakah "${newTitle}" ini quest yang bakal SELESAI SENDIRI kalau waktunya habis (bukan dianggap GAGAL)?`, applyEditQuest);
            } else {
                applyEditQuest();
            }
        }

        function formatDurationHours(h) {
            if (!h || h <= 0) return '-';
            const totalSeconds = Math.round(h * 3600);
            const jam = Math.floor(totalSeconds / 3600);
            const menit = Math.floor((totalSeconds % 3600) / 60);
            const detik = totalSeconds % 60;
            const parts = [];
            if (jam > 0) parts.push(`${jam}j`);
            if (menit > 0) parts.push(`${menit}m`);
            if (detik > 0 || parts.length === 0) parts.push(`${detik}d`);
            return parts.join(' ');
        }

        /* --- MODAL DETAIL QUEST (dipicu geser kiri SAMPAI UJUNG) --- */
        let detailQuestIndex = null;

        function openQuestDetailModal(index) {
            const q = quests[index];
            if (!q) return;
            detailQuestIndex = index;

            document.getElementById('quest-detail-title').innerText = q.title;

            const metaLines = [];
            if (q.label) metaLines.push(`Label: ${q.label}`);
            metaLines.push(`Difficulty: ${q.diff} (+${q.exp} EXP)`);
            if (q.isDaily) metaLines.push(`Tipe: Daily Quest`);
            if (q.isProgressive) metaLines.push(`Progress: ${q.current || 0}/${q.target}`);
            metaLines.push(`Batas Waktu: ${formatDurationHours(q.durationHours)}${q.useCustomTime ? ' (custom)' : ''}`);
            if (q.autoComplete) metaLines.push(`Auto-selesai sendiri saat waktu habis`);
            if (q.unlocked === false) metaLines.push(`Terkunci — butuh "${q.requiresQuestTitle}" selesai dulu`);

            document.getElementById('quest-detail-meta').innerHTML = metaLines.map(l => `<div>${l}</div>`).join('');
            document.getElementById('quest-detail-notes').value = q.notes || '';
            document.getElementById('quest-detail-modal').classList.add('active');
        }

        function closeQuestDetailModal() {
            document.getElementById('quest-detail-modal').classList.remove('active');
            detailQuestIndex = null;
        }

        function saveQuestDetailNotes() {
            if (detailQuestIndex === null) return;
            const q = quests[detailQuestIndex];
            if (!q) { closeQuestDetailModal(); return; }

            q.notes = document.getElementById('quest-detail-notes').value;
            saveData(); refreshUI();
            playEditSound();
            showToast("CATATAN QUEST DISIMPAN!");
            closeQuestDetailModal();
        }

        // Kumpulin semua label unik yang pernah dipake (quest aktif, finished, history,
        // daily preset) buat jadi saran autocomplete di input label — biar user gak
        // salah ketik/beda kapitalisasi pas mau masukin label yang sama.
        function refreshLabelSuggestions() {
            const datalistEl = document.getElementById('quest-label-suggestions');
            if (!datalistEl) return;

            const seen = new Map(); // normalizedLabel -> displayLabel (casing pertama yang ketemu)
            const collectFrom = (arr) => {
                (arr || []).forEach(item => {
                    const raw = (item.label || '').trim();
                    if (!raw) return;
                    const norm = raw.toLowerCase();
                    if (!seen.has(norm)) seen.set(norm, raw);
                });
            };

            collectFrom(quests);
            collectFrom(finishedQuests);
            collectFrom(historyQuests);
            Object.values(dailyPresets).forEach(list => collectFrom(list));

            datalistEl.innerHTML = [...seen.values()]
                .sort((a, b) => a.localeCompare(b))
                .map(lbl => `<option value="${lbl.replace(/"/g, '&quot;')}"></option>`)
                .join('');
        }

        // Semua localStorage key yang dipakai game, dipakai bareng oleh export & import
        const BACKUP_KEYS = ['rpg_hunter', 'rpg_quests', 'rpg_finished', 'rpg_history', 'rpg_achieve', 'rpg_daily_presets', 'rpg_goals', 'rpg_notepad', 'rpg_boss'];

        function exportGameData() {
            saveData(); // pastikan state di memori kesimpen dulu ke localStorage

            const backup = { _app: 'solve-towards-better', _version: 1, _exportedAt: new Date().toISOString(), data: {} };
            BACKUP_KEYS.forEach(key => {
                const raw = localStorage.getItem(key);
                if (raw !== null) backup.data[key] = raw;
            });

            const blob = new Blob([JSON.stringify(backup, null, 2)], { type: 'application/json' });
            const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
            const a = document.createElement('a');
            const dateStr = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
            a.href = url;
            a.download = `solve-backup-${dateStr}.json`;
            document.body.appendChild(a);
            a.click();
            document.body.removeChild(a);
            URL.revokeObjectURL(url);

            showToast('DATA BERHASIL DI-EXPORT!');
        }

        function handleImportFileSelected(event) {
            const file = event.target.files && event.target.files[0];
            event.target.value = ''; // reset biar bisa pilih file yang sama lagi nanti
            if (!file) return;

            const reader = new FileReader();
            reader.onload = () => {
                let parsed;
                try {
                    parsed = JSON.parse(reader.result);
                } catch (err) {
                    showToast('FILE TIDAK VALID (BUKAN JSON)!');
                    return;
                }

                const payload = parsed && parsed.data ? parsed.data : parsed; // tetap bisa terima raw object lama
                if (!payload || typeof payload !== 'object' || !payload.rpg_hunter || !payload.rpg_quests) {
                    showToast('FILE BACKUP TIDAK DIKENALI!');
                    return;
                }

                showConfirmModal('Import bakal NIMPA semua data sekarang (quest, hunter, history, dll). Lanjut?', function() {
                    applyImportedData(payload);
                });
            };
            reader.onerror = () => showToast('GAGAL BACA FILE!');
            reader.readAsText(file);
        }

        function applyImportedData(payload) {
            BACKUP_KEYS.forEach(key => {
                if (payload[key] !== undefined && payload[key] !== null) {
                    const value = typeof payload[key] === 'string' ? payload[key] : JSON.stringify(payload[key]);
                    localStorage.setItem(key, value);
                } else {
                    localStorage.removeItem(key);
                }
            });

            showToast('DATA BERHASIL DI-IMPORT! Reloading...');
            setTimeout(() => location.reload(), 800);
        }

        /* --- PAGE INIT --- */
        // FIX: setInterval browser di-throttle/dipause total saat tab/layar HP
        // dikunci atau app diminimize, jadi HP/MP kerasa "berhenti regen".
        // Begitu app kebuka/kelihat lagi, langsung paksa hitung ulang regen

            }
        });

        // --- PWA: Service Worker inline (via Blob), biar app tetap 1 file HTML ---
        // Cuma jalan kalau app dibuka lewat https:// atau http://localhost
        // (browser gak izinin Service Worker di file:// lokal).
        if ('serviceWorker' in navigator) {
            const swCode = `
                const CACHE_NAME = 'solve-app-cache-v1';
                self.addEventListener('install', (e) => {
                    self.skipWaiting();
                    e.waitUntil(
                        caches.open(CACHE_NAME).then((cache) => cache.add(self.registration.scope))
                    );
                });
                self.addEventListener('activate', (e) => {
                    e.waitUntil(self.clients.claim());
                });
                self.addEventListener('fetch', (e) => {
                    e.respondWith(
                        caches.match(e.request).then((cached) => {
                            const fetchPromise = fetch(e.request).then((resp) => {
                                if (resp && resp.ok) {
                                    caches.open(CACHE_NAME).then((cache) => cache.put(e.request, resp.clone()));
                                }
                                return resp;
                            }).catch(() => cached);
                            return cached || fetchPromise;
                        })
                    );
                });
            `;
            const swBlob = new Blob([swCode], { type: 'text/javascript' });
            const swUrl = URL.createObjectURL(swBlob);
            navigator.serviceWorker.register(swUrl).catch(() => {
                // Diem-diem aja kalau gagal (misal lagi dibuka via file://), app tetap jalan normal
            });
        }

                checkBossWeeklyReset();
                purgeOldHistory();
                checkGoalsDeadline();
                // Munculin System Alert pas boot overlay udah beres, bukan barengan.
                afterBootAnimation(showSystemAlert);
            } else {
                document.getElementById('init-username').focus();
            }

            refreshUI();
        });
    </script>
